articleTitle: Decentralized Defenses: A Framework for 5G IoT Security in Industry 4.0 using Blockchain Crowdsourcing
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This research work presents Blockchain Crowdsourcing-empowered 5G IoT as a backbone for network security of industry 4.0 in various applications. The study examines this aspect by featuring blockchain based crowdsourcing to detect and mitigate attacks. A structured literature search on the topic was conducted on various relevant bibliographic databases. 39 publications fulfilled the inclusion criteria. The study indicates that IoT devices in 5G ecosystems have serious security risk due to evolving threats and there are no proactive solutions. However, the best way to respond effectively is to work at the edge of the communication network using the density of IoT devices to obtain and analyze information, then taking corrective measures from the source of the threat. To the author's knowledge, this is the first study to apply the Blockchain based Crowdsourcing tool to mitigate cyber-attacks on 5G IoT networks for Industry 4.0. It has no single point of failure and caters to the increasing demand of cyber security workforce.

articleTitle: AI based Emotion Aware Music Composition using Spotify App
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Users' emotions and moods can be inferred from their facial expressions. The live video from the system camera reveals these expressions. Many researches have been carried out in the fields of machine learning (ML) and computer vision to teach robots to identify various human emotions or moods. Numerous techniques for identifying human emotions are provided by machine learning. Our proposed method is a music player which works the human mood-based and it provides song recommendations in terms of the real-time mood detection. This is now a capability that is linked with the standard music player application that come preinstalled on our phones. The objectives of this method are to study the user's look, forecast their facial expression, and suggest music based on mood. The discipline of music creation has changed dramatically as a result of technical improvements, providing new avenues for artists and composers to create captivating and emotionally stirring musical works. The concept of “Emotional-Aware Music Composition,” a cutting-edge technique that employs artificial intelligence and machine learning to give compositions a profound emotional authenticity, is explored in this abstract. Emotionally aware music creation allows composers to produce music that not only transfers emotion but also deeply engages listeners by bridging the gap between human creativity and technological prowess. This multidisciplinary field uses components from psychology, music theory, and machine learning to achieve this.

articleTitle: A Novel Hybrid Load Balancing Method to Achieve Quality of Service(QoS) in Cloud-Based Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Cloud computing has emerged as a significant paradigm, providing scalable and on-demand service delivery. However, maintaining Quality of Service (QoS) remains as a major concern. A fundamental approach, load balancing, attempts to enhance resource utilization and reduce response time by efficiently distributing incoming requests across servers. To address the dynamic nature of cloud workloads, this research study presents a hybrid strategy to combine static and dynamic solutions. To achieve higher load-balancing performance, the proposed technique combines the advantages of static load balancing and dynamic Ant Colony Optimization (ACO). The proposed approach is then tested using QoS measures, such as response time and resource utilization by using a prototype or simulation.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Accounting with Blockchain Technology for Enhanced Security and Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: In recent years, blockchain technology has become more popular in many fields as it can make things safer and efficient. In future, blockchain technology could be very helpful for the financial field. Accounting is an important part of any business, and the success of the business depends on how accurate and reliable it is. On the other hand, traditional accounting methods are slow and prone to mistakes that can cost a lot of money. Blockchain technology has the potential to change the accounting field by making it safer, open and efficient. People have said that the blockchain technology is a revolutionizing technology that can change many fields, including accounting. Cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin use a technology called decentralized and distributed ledger, which could be used to make financial systems safer and more efficient. This study will discuss about how blockchain technology could change accounting and what benefits it might have.

articleTitle: A New Framework for Microservices with Single Sign-On, Security Assertion Markup Language and OpenID Connect
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Integrated global Single Sign-On (SSO) module is a security module for microservices which can be used to perform the basic authentication and authorization process in terms of user level and resources level. In general, micro services are the individual components which are executed separately for different purposes. In general, each individual service can communicate with external authentication mechanism to get validated in terms of identity and access check. But it is a complicated process for the services which are deployed individually because each service has to communicate with the authentication mechanism to get verified. In existing security models, the microservices are controlled through Auth 2.0 entity, Client Application and Authorization server individually. Therefore, this research study proposing an integrated framework called “BridG” identifies and connect all type of microservices with local and global network systems. The BridG framework has SSO module, Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) and OpenID Connect (OlD C) to get authenticated and authorized for the individual microservices.

articleTitle: Early Detection and Warning System for Earthquakes Using Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: For organizations and governments around the world disaster management is a crucial area of concern. There is a growing demand for effective and efficient disaster management systems due to the frequency and severity of natural and man-made disasters. A viable way to improve disaster management skills is possible because of the development of the Internet of Things (IoT). IoT-based disaster management system enhances preparedness, response, and recovery efforts by utilizing networked devices, sensors, and data analytics. In this work, a complete and real-time catastrophe management framework is created using the advantages of sensor-based monitoring and IoT. This work offers capabilities for real-time monitoring combined with early warning of earthquakes which provides room for effective resource allocation for disaster management. By implementing such a system, communities can become much more resilient overall and save money and lives during critical situations.

articleTitle: Hybrid Machine Learning Based Shill Bidding Fraud Detection System Using Recursive Feature Elimination Method
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Due to the significant surge in internet traffic and the increasing complexity of networks, manual monitoring of traffic flows and intrusion detection in large networks has become an overwhelming task for network analysts. Maintaining information security is of paramount importance, with fraud detection playing a crucial role in this endeavour. Recently, the adoption of Machine Learning (ML) methods for intrusion detection has also gained substantial popularity. The vast volume of data generated by network traffic often contains irrelevant features, resulting in slower detection processes and diminished system performance. To address this issue, feature elimination or selection is carried out before classification. In this research, a Shill Bidding Fraud Detection system leverages a Hybrid machine learning approach and incorporates a recursive feature elimination method. To ensure a thorough and effective analysis of network traffic for intrusion detection, we combined Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Decision Tree (DT) machine learning models into a hybrid framework. Additionally, we established a multi-class classifier capable of not only distinguishing between malicious and benign traffic but also extending labels to categorize various forms of malicious data. To optimize system performance, This study has identified and eliminated irrelevant features using the Recursive Feature Elimination method. Experimental results demonstrate a significant enhancement in the performance of network intrusion detection.

articleTitle: IoT based Wireless Alert System for Individuals with Impaired Hearing
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Humans' relationships with the environment are revolutionized by the Internet of Things (IoT), especially with disadvantaged groups like the deaf population. Individuals with hearing impairments are frequently not alerted by conventional auditory alerts, leaving them vulnerable to risks and disconnected from vital information. The alarm system suggested in this study is IoT-based and warns non-hearing users by valuing their safety with its greatest priority. The technology uses multiple vibration frequencies to notify the user and smart wearables like smart watches to display live footage of the outside environment while it is being recorded by a camera. This novel strategy promises to close the current communication gap and improve the deaf community's standard of living. The IoT ecosystem's interconnected gadgets provide advantages like improved communication, increased independence, and greater inclusion. The revolutionary potential of an Internet of Things-based alert system for the deaf community emphasizes how crucial technology is to promoting accessibility, safety, and equitable participation for everyone.

articleTitle: Voice-based Mobile Phone Brand Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Brand identification is important for security, marketing, and user experience as the use of mobile devices increases. This study uses Mel Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC) and the Random Forest algorithm to develop an innovative approach for voice-based brand identification for mobile devices. The process of identifying and confirming the legitimacy of a brand using audio data, such as brand-specific music, slogans, or conversations, is known as voice-based brand identification. Due to its ability to offer safe access to branded services and improve user experience, it is of major importance to both businesses and consumers. In this study, a comprehensive framework for voice-based brand identification is proposed. The foundation of our methodology is the extraction and examination of MFCC features. The distinctive spectrum characteristics of audio signals are captured by MFCC features, which makes them useful for brand-specific identification. The Random Forest method is used for categorization, offering an authentic and precise way to differentiate between various brands. Using the MFCC feature set as input, the Random Forest model is trained and refined for identifying brands. The outcomes show that the system is capable of accurately and effectively identifying brands. Performance measurements included accuracy, precision, recall and F1 score. This study contributes to the rapidly developing field of audio-based brand recognition and creates emerging possibilities for improving mobile device security and user experiences.

articleTitle: Face and Emotion Recognition using Deep Learning with Convolutional Neural Networks in Industry Application
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Today's industry areas have more employees since the field is currently the most popular in the world. Everyone wants to be employed in one of the well-known industries and contribute to humanity's advancement by developing as many new things as possible. However, all of these activities and jobs impose both mental and physical stress. Employees who are unable to maintain their health need to take rest and avoid working extra hours. However, there are many ways in which people may work in a stable environment while still progressing and maintaining a healthy work-life balance. The concept of emotion recognition is not new, and it is applied in a variety of industries. This study analyzes how it helps in the industrial environment. This research investigates how emotion detection may be applied in MNCs and other sectors and discusses how the proposed CNN model helps in the classification of emotions. Here, the emotion is captured and detected using OpenCV, and an Email is sent to the identified recipient over SMTP based on the emotion recognized. Thus, the proposed approach has the potential to benefit people.

articleTitle: Monitoring of Smart Human Resource (HR) Using Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The usage of AI and IoT technology in smart HR has generated a IoT of attention in recent years. This research paper explores the potential applications of smart HR. AI and IoT Examining the study on AI and IoT technology and its impact on developing, reinforcing and changing the culture of an organization. It also discusses the potential benefits and challenges of incorporating AI and IoT in smart HR including analyzing employee interactions to identify behavior that could lead to issues or litigation software and other technologies The goal of this study is to analyze the benefit of industrial revolution 4.0. The study finds that AI and IoT have the potential to change how employees engage with goods and shops, and can offer unique and engaging shopping experiences that can increase employees satisfaction and loyalty. However, there are still several technological, logistical, and ethical challenges that must be addressed before AI and IoT become effectively be woven into an employee on boarding program.

articleTitle: IoT Trends-Network Architecture and IDS Strategies using AI: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: In this era of IoT and Artificial Intelligence, many electronic and smart devices are connected to other smart devices such as smart AC, washing-machine and smart lights through the Internet. IoT devices can be accessed remotely through our Smartphones or laptops. IoT is an ecosystem of interconnected things that communicate with each other. These smart devices gather, share, and analyze information and perform required actions. IoT network devices need to be secured to avoid misuse. Artificial intelligence-based IDS provide security to these smart devices and their network. This paper provides a detailed insight into an IoT network, trends, and security to this network or smart devices using AI. An artificial intelligence-based machine learning approach with IDS can be used to improve the security of an IoT network. An IoT network security improves by using an IDS created by AI.

articleTitle: A Neural Network-Based Approach to Forecasting Bankruptcy Using Feature Importance Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This research work addresses the critical problem of developing a reliable bankruptcy prediction model. Accurately predicting bankruptcy is essential to the stability of the economy, and existing methods have limitations that may lead to business failure. In this research, we aim to overcome these limitations and develop a more accurate bankruptcy forecasting method. To do this, we discuss the issue of unequal class sizes and the relative importance of various forms of misclassification. After identifying the most important financial characteristics using feature importance analysis, we employ neural networks to predict if a company will fail in the next years. To improve the model's performance, we adjust the parameters using Grid Search Cross Validation. The accuracy of bankruptcy predictions might be greatly increased with our suggested methodology, which would also increase economic stability.

articleTitle: YouTube Video Summarizer in Regional Language
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The idea and features of the proposed You Tube video summarizer tool created especially for regional languages is presented in this research study. Generally, it is a challenging task for viewers, who prefer regional languages to access and understand videos that are primarily available in a different language in YouTube. The proposed You Tube video summarizer in regional language attempts to overcome this challenge by offering a service to summarize videos in regional languages, making them easier for viewers who might not understand the original language of the video to access and comprehend. The developed program analyses and extracts important information from the video's audio or subtitles using natural language processing (NLP) and machine learning algorithms. This YouTube video summarizer in local languages has a wide range of potential uses. It can improve non-English speakers' access to information, improve video browsing, and promote effective content consumption in localized language groups.

articleTitle: Navigating the Waves of Precision: Optimization Techniques for Sailfish Segmentation in the Pacific
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: A well-known and mysterious species that lives in the vast and varied seas of the Pacific Ocean is the Indo-Pacific sailfish. The sailfish has piqued the interest of marine scientists, ecologists, and fans alike because of its unusual sail-like dorsal fin and amazing speed. Its existence as a pelagic predator, searching the ocean floor, provides a special insight into the mystifying workings of the marine ecosystem. In addition to being magnificent in their natural habitat, sailfish are crucial to comprehending the dynamics of the ecosystems of the Pacific Ocean. In essence, “Navigating the Waves of Precision” makes a substantial contribution to the study of marine biology and the analysis of underwater images. This study extends the instruments available for the conservation and scientific study of Indo-Pacific sailfish, enabling a greater comprehension of these extraordinary creatures and their crucial role in the Pacific environment. The present work offers useful insights into choosing the best optimization approach based on the particular needs of the sailfish segmentation problem through thorough experimentation and reviews. It also increases the precision and efficacy of sailfish segmentation.

articleTitle: A Real Time Prediction Model for Round Winners of Counter Strike:Global Offensive
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This research study aims to create a full time winner predictor program for Counter-Strike Global Offensive tournaments that can predict the round winner of the game being spectated. The algorithm creates accurate predictions of the round winner. The data required for the prediction has to be extracted from the game servers. The data is collected from the game servers using an API. The prediction can be viewed live by the user with the help of a GUI. The project can provide CS:GO enthusiasts and bettors with real-time insights and predictions for round winners in competitive matches. System aims to enhance the user's understanding of match dynamics and support informed decision making.

articleTitle: Fuzzy K-Means Clustering with ML Algorithm for Efficient Keyword Search
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Data mining ecompasses enormous technologies to mine data from various resources. In day-to-day lives, people are latched with web-based search engines. Whatever data they need can be obtained in a fraction of a second using web search engines. Every user may have diffrent search goals, and also some keywords may have similar spelling but different meanings. This study intends to develop prediction mechanisms to display the requested information for the user based on the requirements. Further, this research study proposes a novel approach to deliver exact results in order to reduce the time-consuming process. This research study has proposed a fuzzy k-means clustering algorithm with a KNN-based improved feedback section method to bring out the best classification results for the posed user requiremnts.

articleTitle: Role of Blockchain Technologies in Goods and Services Tax
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Technology is rooted in every field. Timely and accurate tax collection is a big change for tax authority. This can be solved by using technologies like artificial intelligence, blockchain technology, internet of thing and robotic system. The purpose of the study was to discover the potential applications and benefits of blockchain technology in the Goods and Services Tax (GST) system. This exhibits how blockchain can increase transparency, streamline compliance, improve auditability, secure data management, streamline supply chain management, and facilitate cross-border transactions under the GST framework provide detailed analysis on how they can promote. This study also discusses about the challenges and contemplations associated with implementing blockchain in the GST system. This study intends to offer a complete overview of the blockchain technology in the GST domain by examining existing literature, case studies & expert opinion.

articleTitle: Khaugalli.com: A Cutting-Edge Solution for Informed Meal Selection
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Finding a suitable and reliable dining solution for daily meals can be a challenging task for individuals, including students and working professionals. To address this problem, a model was developed as a comprehensive web-based application. Leveraging various front end and supportive backend solutions this model offers a convenient solution by simplifying the search for the best menu in the nearby area. Users can easily compare menus and place orders, saving valuable time and effort in the process. This user-friendly platform aims to cater to the needs of both students and working professionals, providing a streamlined and efficient way to select and order meals on a daily basis.

articleTitle: DeepSpine: Multi-Class Spine X-Ray Conditions Classification Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Addressing the complex challenges inherent in the automated analysis of spine X-rays, our research introduces DeepSpine, a deep learning model designed for multi-class classification of diverse spine conditions. Employing convolutional neural networks (CNNs), DeepSpine exhibits remarkable proficiency in identifying various abnormalities, including Scoliosis, Osteochondrosis, Osteoporosis, Spondylolisthesis, Vertebral Compression Fractures (VCFs), Disability, Other and Healthy. Trained on a Kaggle dataset, the model achieves high accuracy and robustness. Incorporating transfer learning techniques enhances DeepSpine's generalization across different datasets, presenting a promising avenue for automated diagnosis and decision support in musculoskeletal radiology. This research contributes to the ongoing intersection of artificial intelligence and medical imaging, showcasing the potential of deep learning to revolutionize spine X-ray analysis and improve clinical outcomes.

articleTitle: Recommendation System for Crop, Fertilizer and Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: In general, rural farmers lack the knowledge and guidance required to cultivate crops that improve agricultural production. Farmers usually grow crops in the same pattern year after year, using the same fertilizers and crop types, this in turn results in the loss of nutrients and minerals required to create healthy crops. Farmers typically struggle to recognize the crop diseases and lacks knowledge in selecting the suitable to grow based on the local conditions. Government-funded initiatives and efforts have been established recently to teach farmers about crops and assist them to become more technologically aware. This study has developed a novel crop recommendation model to advice farmers about which crops to plant, where and how to prevent crop diseases, and what type of fertilizer to use. The proposed application also allows farmers to update or report crop-related issues for public access, including recommendations for certain disease cures. This application also gives advice on how to cultivate healthy crops, suggest fertilizers, and get assistance with crop disease issues by integrating various Machine Learning (ML) technologies. This study also initiates to create a blog to connect farmers globally and allows them to exchange difficulties and information on various crop diseases by using Flask.

articleTitle: Optimization of Blockchain Digital Currency Privacy Protection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This study presents a comprehensive investigation of an optimized privacy protection algorithm tailored for blockchain-based digital currencies. With a primary focus on addressing the privacy concerns inherent in Initial Coin Offerings (ICO) and the complexities arising from digital asset transactions, the study introduces a novel blockchain model. This model encompasses different blockchain types, emphasizing identity, performance, access rights, consensus mechanisms, and application scenarios. The consensus mechanism, specifically Practical Byzantine Fault Tolerance (PBFT), plays a key role in achieving secure and efficient decentralized transactions. In addition, cryptographic techniques, in particular the hash (Merkle) tree structure, are integrated to enhance security and integrity. The research concludes with experimental evaluations that demonstrate significant improvements in user anonymity and unlinkability, critical factors for preserving user privacy in blockchain networks. This work provides valuable insights into the optimization of privacy protection mechanisms in blockchain-based digital currencies, promoting improved security and efficiency in various applications.

articleTitle: Wireless Power Transfer Systems for Electric Vehicle Application based on IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: In today's technology world, the urge for sustainable development has made people to utilize Electric Vehicles. This has greatly affected the significant price hike in gasoline fuel. Few people are unwilling to purchase an electric car because of the absence of a charging infrastructure; however, a relatively less percentage of the population is willing to do so. Despite the availability of charging stations, most of the time is spent waiting for drivers to refuel the cars. Electronic multi-functional devices and electrical vehicles, both can be charged via wireless power exchange. This study discusses about various wireless power transfer methods, along with how they relate to power transmitted for electric vehicles via wireless technologies. An inductive force transmission method is also suggested in this study. Finally, a simulation was run, followed by an experimental implementation. Testing was also conducted with various alignment and distance scenarios, and a 90% efficiency rate was attained.

articleTitle: Optimizing AWS Cloud Infrastructure: An Analysis of Cloud-Nuke's Impact on Productivity, Cost Efficiency, and Resource Management
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The quantitative effect of Cloud-Nuke on resource optimization in Amazon Web Services (AWS) settings is assessed in this study. Key performance indicators (KPIs) are the main focus of the study in order to evaluate how well the solution simplifies cloud infrastructure administration. After doing methodical testing, Cloud-Nuke demonstrated outstanding outcomes. 60% decrease in resource deletion time as compared to manual approaches is the first noteworthy outcome. This demonstrates how Cloud-Nuke can quickly eliminate unnecessary resources, greatly improving operational efficiency. Cloud-Nuke's ability to detect and remove superfluous resources has resulted in a 40% drop in monthly AWS billings, which is an equally amazing impact on cost savings. Additional investigation reveals a high accuracy rate of 95% in classifying and removing different kinds of resources, reducing the possibility of unintentional removals. This highlights the tool's dependability in resource cleansing and allays worries about accuracy in cloud asset management. optimized AWS environment and enhanced system performance are clear indications of Cloud-Nuke's operational effect. Through improved resource visibility and less clutter, Cloud-Nuke helps create a cloud infrastructure that is more efficient and well-organized.

articleTitle: Enhancing Operational Efficiency and User Experience in Virtual Workspaces: A Comprehensive Analysis and Action Plan
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The effectiveness and user experience of virtual collaboration technologies become critical as the distant work environment changes. The conclusions and recommendations drawn from a thorough examination of the “Virtual Workspace” feature—a crucial part of the cloud-based collaboration capabilities offered by a fictional SaaS company—are summarized in this abstract. Key operational obstacles were found by the investigation, including inconsistent user engagement, platform responsiveness, and connectivity problems. The diverse range of experiences had by prominent individuals like Elon Musk, Sundar Pichai, and others highlights the complexity of these issues. The remedies that are suggested take a comprehensive approach, addressing technical issues by means of network infrastructure upgrades, honing platform responsiveness through focused development sprints, and encouraging user participation by means of feature improvements. Establishing an ongoing feedback loop and monitoring system also guarantees proactive problem detection and fixing.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Predictive Analytics for Employees Turnover with Performance Prediction in Banking Sector
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The banking sector is a dynamic and competitive environment. Predictive analytics is necessary to monitor employee turnover and predict performance. This is initiated using the proposed system which involves deep learning techniques. The Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) helps in extracting the information regarding the diverse data which involves employee performance, historical turnover and satisfaction factors. The convolutional layers help in automatically identifying the necessary information from the data. The sequential and time-dependent parameters of the employee turnover prediction are done using a Recurrent Neural Network (RNN). The banking sector provides temporal workforce data where RNN can able to capture patterns in the dynamic nature of employee performance and identification of potential turnover indicators. The gradient problem in the system is solved using Long Short-Term Memory networks. Employee behaviour and performance are the early indicators of potential turnover in banking sectors. The proposed system helps to forecast employee performance and turnover based on trend analysis. The various factors that influence turnover and performance are individual performance metrics, job satisfaction and market trends. The proposed system has the ability to adapt to the dynamic environment while providing continuous improvement.

articleTitle: Increasing Scalability, Data Management, and Processing for Internet of Things Applications in Cloud-based IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is a network of interconnected computing devices operating in a decentralized and always- evolving system. Many widely dispersed, diverse, and small items with limited storage, energy, and computing capacities make up the Internet of items. These constraints pose difficult problems, such as interoperability, scalability, performance, and availability, that hinder the development of IoT applications. One interesting solution that can be combined with IoT to get over these restrictions is cloud computing. The cloud is a common infrastructure that allows the centralization of many functions (network, storage, computation, and software) and virtualization. This research study introduces a cloud-based IoT platform and discusses about its features, such as data storage, computing power, and connectivity. When it comes to collecting, transmitting, analyzing, processing, and storing the data, this platform can make use of the infrastructure and services provided by the cloud. This study also voices out for the organizations that adopted cloud-based IoT technology.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Analysis on Virtual Reality Technology and its Security
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Virtual Reality has created such a boom over the years and is continuing to do so. Virtual Reality in general serves as an on demand service of technology by allowing humans to interact with computer-simulated interface. While the equitable cost of Virtual Reality model can seem expensive but that will offer a decent Return on Investment and can completely refine your business entity. All the hype of this new technology is assisted with various issues. This paper mainly focuses on the security issues regarding the infrastructure; the stored data and secures data transfer, future prospects, various legal and regulatory issues of the virtual reality which are the major concerns that are preventing people to embrace virtual reality.

articleTitle: Smart Video Processing in the Cloud
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This study capitalizes on cloud technology to revolutionize video processing, offering real-time object detection and labeling. Users can effortlessly upload videos via our user-friendly web portal, initiating cloud-based analysis for applications in security, surveillance, and home automation. Our system's design prioritizes privacy, ensuring sensitive data remains unexposed. With a commitment to accessibility and usability, the study fosters more interactive and intelligent video content. This initiative marks a significant stride toward unlocking the full potential of video in an increasingly digital world, empowering users to derive valuable insights from visual media while safeguarding their privacy and data

articleTitle: ML Integrated Facial Expression Recognition on Occluded Faces Using Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Facial expression recognition is becoming a core part of human-computer interaction and emotion detecting systems. However, the real-time scenarios such as the widespread use of face masks presents a big challenge to traditional facial recognition systems. This work proposes a new approach by integrating machine learning concepts, particularly in neural networks and feature fusion. Our main goal is to develop an accurate facial recognition system that can recognize expressions even when the face is partially visible. To achieve this process, we will take a diverse dataset containing images of faces with variable occlusion. Using Data pre-processing techniques, it standardized the training and evaluation procedure. The obtained results conclude the model's ability to accurately recognize facial expressions even in the presence of occluded faces. To achieve this objective, this research work has proposed a Squeeze and Excitation Network (SE-Net) to enhance the relationship in convolutional feature maps. The proposed feature fusion technique combines the local features and global features. Moreover, it creates opportunities for enabling more consideration into scientific research and the synthesis of data from various inputs by eventually validating more complex situations.

articleTitle: Novel Security Monitoring System for Sports Expansion Activities Based on Smart Bracelet Positioning Equipment
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This article introduces a novel safety monitoring system for sports development activities using smart wristband positioning devices. The development potential of the outdoor sports industry is recognized, emphasizing the need for effective management to ensure safety. The proposed safety monitoring system integrates smart bracelets with positioning equipment to enhance safety during outdoor activities. The literature review examines previous studies in sports-related monitoring and control systems, highlighting advances in the technology and its applications. Various studies on smart bracelets, wearable technologies and monitoring systems contribute to the understanding of the proposed methodology The proposed methodology consists of a positioning system using UM220-IIIGPS and STM8S microprocessor for efficient global positioning. The advantages of the system include simplicity, reliability, and cost effectiveness. In addition, a smart wristband system with health monitoring functions is designed, which incorporates a bidirectional DC/DC converter for power management using solar energy as a power source. Verification of the design scheme includes test data examples for smart bracelet metrics, STM32 battery system, and bidirectional DC/DC converter. The designed smart bracelet is presented as a compact wearable health tracking device

articleTitle: Ballot Casting System using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The blockchain-based voting system is emerging efficient technology as it reduces voting costs and increases voter turnout. This technology lets people to vote from anywhere with an Internet connection by eliminating the need to visit a physical polling center. The primary challenge faced by internet voting is its security. To overcome this challenge, the decentralized and distributed blockchain technology is preferred. It provides tamper-proof and visible voting records, ensuring that the votes are dependable, accurate, and secure. This study has developed a blockchain-based e-ballot application to provide a secure electronic voting system that offers the same degree of equality and privacy as existing voting services but with the added transparency and flexibility that electronic voting systems provide. The purpose of employing blockchain as a service, in conjunction with distributed ledger technologies to construct an electronic voting system is to address the drawbacks faced by existing voting system while also making it more cost efficient. To summarize, blockchain-based voting systems may be able to overcome some of the challenges that now hinder political decision-making.

articleTitle: Real Time Poisoning Attacks and Privacy Strategies on Machine Learning Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Machine Learning aims to learn computer systems and predict output. Nowadays, Deep learning uses continuous training based on a large network of interconnected neurons to mimic the way humans think, analyze, and make decisions. It plays an important role in real-time applications. There are some security and privacy threats faced by deep learning systems. One of the major threats faced by such learning systems is attacks during training. The manipulation of training data leads to poisoning attacks. The resulting models are severely impacted by poisoning attacks, which may prevent them from converging or alter the outcomes of their predictions. The need to defend against such poisoning attacks is urgent and difficult. This study explains a thorough and detailed analysis of different types of poisoning attacks in real time applications. Its countermeasures to mitigate such attacks and various privacy-enhancing methods are also discussed here.

articleTitle: CLSTM-DQN Fusion for AI-Driven Broken Chord Melodies
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This research study introduces an innovative approach by employing LSTM networks to generate broken chord compositions, capturing nuanced harmonies and rhythms inherent in this fragmented structure. Trained on annotated sequences, the model adeptly retains the arpeggiated essence of broken chords. Leveraging LSTM networks, attention mechanisms, and meticulous architectural refinements, this method substantially elevates the quality and ingenuity of the compositions generated. The research significantly contributes to AI-driven music generation by offering robust composition support and personalized music recommendations.

articleTitle: Mental Fitness Analysis and Tracking System using Exploratory Data Analysis [EDA] and Regression Supervised Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This research study focuses on the idea of designing an Android application ‘Mental Fitness Analyzer’ to monitor the mental condition of an individual and visualize the cause of major mental illness using Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) techniques. Mental health of any particular person can be tracked by using the chatbot feature of the proposed application. Recently, different algorithms are used for analysing and finding out the optimal solution. The proposed system uses Exploratory Data Analysis [EDA] and Regression Supervised Algorithm to investigate and visualize the factors that cause mental illness. This study uses Natural Language Processing (Sentiment Analysis) to differentiate the user's state of being. Further, the realization methods are used to get a clear visualization (graphical representation) of the factors that have adverse effects on the user's mental state. The regression method is used to study the connection between the relative variables, which helps in modelling the futuristic relationship between the variables. Thus, the proposed system helps any individual to understand his/her mental state and lead a healthy life.

articleTitle: Analysis of Revolutionizing IoT Solutions through Cloud Computing Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This research work investigates the significant potential for increasing productivity and promoting innovation in a range of sectors presented by the combination of DevOps, Cloud Computing, and Internet of Things IoT. The transformational influence of this convergence is presented quantitatively in this research. Our findings highlighted the efficiency improvements of the integrated strategy in the field of IoT deployment, showing a noteworthy 71.67% decrease in deployment time when compared to traditional techniques. Furthermore, the integration demonstrated its potential for cost reductions by enabling a 37.5% decrease in expenses through dynamic resource scaling. This connection enabled real-time data analysis, which led to an astounding 91.67% decrease in reaction time when compared to conventional data analysis techniques. This demonstrates how it may provide real-time insights that are essential for Internet of Things applications. This study offers strong quantitative proof that the confluence of IoT, cloud computing, and DevOps is a route to increased productivity and creativity that has the ability to transform sectors and propel advancement in the digital age.

articleTitle: AIOps in DevOps: Leveraging Artificial Intelligence for Operations and Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This research work investigates the significant effects of implementing AIOps (Artificial Intelligence for IT Operations) on many aspects of system management and IT infrastructure performance improvement. AIOps led to a 15% improvement in anomaly detection accuracy, a 30% decrease in system outages, a 50% increase in incident management effectiveness, and a 15% reduction in cloud infrastructure costs. These developments show how AI-driven solutions have a big influence on IT operations and hold the promise of more dependable and effective systems. A hybrid approach combining supervised and unsupervised learning technique is proposed for anomaly detection, showcasing improved accuracy compared to traditional rule-based methods. Predictive analytics using time series analysis and forecasting models enables proactive issue resolution by detecting resource constraints and preventing performance bottlenecks. NLP techniques are explored for automating incident management, resulting in significant time savings and improved accuracy.

articleTitle: Farming in the Digital Age: AI-Infused Digital Twins for Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This research study reveals a transformative impact on farming practices, showcasing increased productivity, resource efficiency, and sustainable agriculture. The study demonstrates that AI-infused Digital Twins contribute to a 15-20% average improvement in crop yield, reduce resource consumption by 25%, and lower pest and disease-related losses by 30%. Moreover, precision farming adoption has surged by 40%, and a remarkable 20% reduction in the carbon footprint has been achieved. These findings underscore the significance of AI-infused Digital Twins in ushering agriculture into the digital age while simultaneously promoting productivity and sustainability in the sector. the potential for increased yield, resource efficiency, and sustainability, these digital solutions offer a promising future for the farming sector in the digital age.

articleTitle: Improving Solar Efficiency via CNN-LSTM and Cloud-Integrated IoT Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Photovoltaic panel used in solar power generation is an environmentally beneficial and sustainable energy source that has been used to transform sunlight into electrical power. Arranged in large solar facilities, these panels are connected to a central inverter, which converts Direct Current (DC) to alternating current (AC) electricity with a small amount of energy loss. Clean surfaces, unhindered light exposure, and high solar irradiance are all necessary for optimal panel performance. It's critical to assess the inverter's efficiency by comparing its AC to DC power. Large-scale installations with sensor-equipped panels and inverters track performance to help with maintenance and forecasting of power generation. The Internet of Things (IoT) facilitates data accessibility and remote monitoring, which helps choose the best location for solar power generation. Smart system continuous monitoring expedites site inspections, which supports urban smart grid integration. In this research study, a hybrid machine learning model is presented by combining the attention processes, long short-term memory (LSTM) networks, and clustering approaches. This model is separated into different phases for forecasting, training, and cloud data clustering, finds pertinent historical data, builds a hybrid machine learning model, and chooses the best training model. In comparison to conventional approaches, this method significantly improves prediction accuracy, which is important for integrating photovoltaic systems into smart grids, particularly in smart cities.

articleTitle: Architecture and Attacks in Software Defined Networking, and its Security Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Software Defined Networking (SDN) is a newly developed network that implements hardware components virtually. With SDN, control plane is separated from the underlying hardware and implemented in software. The control plane is called SDN controller which provides a centralized view and network management. By separating the control plane from data plane in SDN, communication management, control, updates, analysis, and understanding can be improved. SDN appears to be a more secure network design than traditional IP-based networks, but it still has significant adoption issues and is open to a variety of network breaches. It must be adequately safeguarded against security risks. This study provides a deep look into SDN architectures and discusses the principal difficulties that SDN architecture must overcome. Also covered various security concerns, such as threats and attacks which limit the development of SDN. This research study also discusses the relevance of machine learning algorithms for intrusion detection in SDN.

articleTitle: Sustainable Agriculture Through IoT-Enabled Vertical Farming
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This study presents an advanced Internet of Things (IoT)-enabled vertical farming system that aims to transform urban sustainable agriculture. The system incorporates web-based technologies for remote crop monitoring and precise environmental data management. Its main features include optimizing soil moisture, efficiently utilizing rainwater, and regulating temperature and humidity. ThingSpeak, an essential system component, is used for data visualization and management. The study details the criteria for selecting high-accuracy sensors and components, highlighting their cost-effectiveness and precision. An OLCD display presents comprehensive farm data, enhancing user management and reducing waste. This innovative VF system contributes to sustainable urban agriculture, increasing food production efficiency and environmental conservation.

articleTitle: Social Media Censoring Using of Visual Sentimental Analyzer
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This research paper proposes a solution to enhance the efficiency of social media platforms in classifying, flagging, and removing potentially vulgar or offensive posts. The aim is to reduce the time taken for such actions by implementing real-time image classification during the uploading process. This dynamic approach is facilitated by leveraging the power of transfer learning through the implementation of Inception v3, a highly accurate pre- trained image recognition model with extensive dataset support. Additionally, the paper presents the development of a user- friendly social media application akin to popular platforms like Instagram and Facebook. The application enables users to upload images accompanied by captions, browse through the posts of their followers, express appreciation through likes, and engage in discussions via comments. Furthermore, users have the ability to search for specific profiles, among other features commonly found in leading social media apps. The primary objective of this paper is to identify and address the limitations of existing image classification systems by introducing a novel model. The proposed model serves as the foundation for building an improved social media application, thus contributing to the overall enhancement of content moderation processes.

articleTitle: IoT based Truck Monitoring System in Coal Mines
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The mining industry is one of the labor intensive industries, which contribute substantially to the GDP of the nation. The minerals like Coal are transported to the warehouse predominantly using the roadways. Due to large influence of labors, the main problem faced by this industry is the Dishonesty or the greed of some workers. This leads to overfilling of container or the truck with the coal or other mineral, and then selling the extra quantity illegally for own profit. This results into significant economic loss of government. Also overfilling the truck can lead to fatal road accidents thus causing loss of life. To tackle this issue proposal of a truck monitoring system which keeps the track of weight loaded in the truck has been made. Also one can keep track on the live location of the truck remotely. Thus the problems stated above can be minimized and the whole process of transportation can be made transparent.

articleTitle: An Extensive Review of Intelligent Deep Learning Based Anomaly Detection and Classification of 3D MRI Brain Imaging Data
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: MRI - Magnetic Resonance Imaging is one of the frequently employed imaging modalities for brain anomaly detection. MRI produces a massive quantity of data, which includes a consecutive set of scans taken at several time instants. Since the existence of brain anomalies that exists examined on every MR sequence, manual brain anomaly detection necessitates anatomical knowledge, costly, laborious, and inaccurate due to human error. Automatic brain anomaly segmentation from 3D Magnetic Resonance Image (MRI) is essential to perform proper diagnosis, monitoring, and treatment planning of the disease. However, owing to the structural difficulties such as hazy boundaries with uneven shapes, precise 3D brain tumor demarcation is interesting. With the recent developments of Deep Learning (DL) models, this research study reviews the recent brain anomaly detection and classification models based on DL approach with 3D MRI data. The existing techniques related to brain tumor segmentation, classification, and validations are reviewed. Every reviewed technique is investigated based on the aim, underlying technique used, dataset, and evaluation parameters. Besides, a comparison table is provided by summarizing the reviewed techniques under several aspects. Finally, a quick analysis of the evaluated techniques' results is conducted to gauge their effectiveness.

articleTitle: TrackBot: Building an Intelligent Multipurpose Line Follower Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Robots are the solutions for replacing humans from dangerous and manual labour. Repetitive, non-creative manual tasks can be automated by using robots. One of the principal approaches to automate robots is by line sensing principle. We create a robot that acquires the front view using a camera mounted on the vehicle then applying few processes in order to detect the lines thereby steering the vehicle autonomously.

articleTitle: Network Media Platform to Build a Sustainable Development of Ecological Environment Using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Social technology has grown rapidly and effectively as a result of new information technology. The importance of the big data approach, which was among the most prominent current occurrences, has improved as a result of the amount of information generated from social media. For the installation of renewable energies, the Energy Network seems to have become a central feature. Because there are so many different sustainable energy sources and how they interact with the grid, the system is extremely complex and presents a number of intrinsic challenges, such as the coordination and monitoring of distributed sustainable energy generation, which can be extremely difficult to handle. This study presents a blockchain-based approach for managing digital information in a network as a solution to these problems. Blockchain is a distributed ledger that implements agreement, inevitability, and transparency for online data using encryption schemes, hash chains, and consensus mechanisms. The suggested approach can employ blockchain's features to achieve efficient network content creation management, copyright management, system administration, and user instructional techniques. Our suggested method can consistently provide the network media platform with crucial assistance, enabling it to pursue long-term, ecologically sustainable expansion.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence based ECG Analysis to Assess Cardiac Health
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Heart disease remains a leading cause of mortality worldwide. Early identification and precise diagnosis are essential for timely intervention and improved patient outcomes. A common diagnostic method for evaluating the condition of the heart is Electrocardiography (ECG). In recent years, advancements in machine learning and artificial intelligence techniques have paved the way for automated analysis of ECG data, providing promising avenues for efficient heart disease detection. This abstract presents a new method of detecting heart problems utilizing ECG data and machine learning algorithms. The system being proposed aims to automate the diagnosis process and assist healthcare professionals in making accurate and timely decisions. The framework contains three essential steps: Preprocessing, feature extraction, and classification of ECG signals.

articleTitle: Thyroid Detection and Recognition Based on Multi-Layer Recursive Neural Network (ML-RNN) Using in Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: One of the most prevalent illnesses in the world is thyroid disease. Over 42 million individuals in India suffer from thyroid gland disorders. All of our metabolic processes are regulated by the thyroid, a little gland in the neck that secretes thyroid hormones. All facets of human health are impacted by thyroid gland dysfunction. Thyroid illness testing is crucial to healing because it necessitates a thorough study. Hormone secretion can be balanced and neutralising problems can be overcome with early diagnosis and treatment of the disease. Numerous patients and a shortage of doctors are posing a threat to conventional diagnosis methods for thyroid disorders. To overcome the issues, deep learning based Multi-Layer Recursive Neural Network (ML-RNN) mainly focuses on pre-processing the input, selecting features based on standard datasets, extracting features from the selected features and classifying thyroid diseases into normal, hyperthyroid and hypothyroidism. First step is preprocessing to improve the obtained values based on clearing, data splitting and handling the missing values. The second stage is feature selection is based on the Fisher score method used for selecting the suboptimal features set. Data information is computed based on Region-of-Interest (ROI) volumes. Classification is based on Multi-Layer Recursive Neural Network (ML-RNN) for analysis of the classification performance based on improving the accuracy and predicting the risk getting thyroid disease. The accuracy, recall, predicted positive value, and predicted negative value of the classification results were high respectively.

articleTitle: Design of Crop Classification Model Based on Soil Information
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The adoption of contemporary techniques to boost agricultural output is unavoidable given worries about the growth of the world's population and the scarcity of food. Artificial neural networks (ANN) in particular have attracted interest recently for the analysis of agricultural data so that farmers may maximise resource allocation, reduce waste, and improve overall efficiency by accurately identifying their crops, giving farmers useful information for making data-driven crop production decisions. ANNs are capable of learning intricate correlations between input characteristics and output labels. The paper proposes an ANN model that classifies crops based on a variety of soil properties. 22 different crops are included in the data collection. The study provides a comparative study of different ANN models with respect to activation function and loss function yielding 8 different models. The proposed model correctly detects crop types using specific soil parameters. This study aids in the creation of simple farming solutions that facilitate decision-making and raise overall agricultural productivity.

articleTitle: Real-Time Environmental Monitoring and Control for Ensuring Optimal Temperature and Humidity Conditions for Patient Comfort and Medical Equipment Integrity
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Ensuring precise environmental parameters, particularly in terms of temperature and humidity, is crucial for both patient safety and the longevity of essential medical equipment. This innovative solution utilizes IoT technologies, featuring the DHT11 sensor-equipped ESP32 micro controller, for continuous data collection and secure transmission to the Blynk platform's cloud server. The selection of the DHT11 sensor is based on its attributes, including accuracy, cost-effectiveness, precision, and reliability, for providing real-time temperature and humidity data. The intelligent control logic autonomously responds to deviations in environmental conditions, triggering corrective actions such as activating cooling, heating, or humidity control mechanisms. This real-time surveillance system empowers healthcare institutions to manage environmental conditions actively, ultimately enhancing patient comfort and safeguarding the integrity of medical equipment. The project's adaptability and scalability cater to diverse healthcare needs, contributing to an elevated standard of patient care and healthcare facility functionality. The ESP32's control logic maintains ideal conditions by continuously checking and initiating actions in response to deviations from predefined thresholds. By harnessing the potential of IoT and cloud technology, this initiative significantly improves patient well-being and enhances the overall quality of healthcare services.

articleTitle: Alternative and Augmentative Communication Device for Paralytic Patients
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Several medical disorders cause motor function loss that limits physical movement and may inhibit speech. In numerous instances like these, individuals may lose their capacity to interact with the outside world in the typical manner of an ordinary person. However, his cognition is mostly unaffected. This study intends to design and build an Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) device that takes user input in the form of blows using a blow sensor. This signal is pre-processed to make it usable and avoid false trigger. It is then given to the processor which takes required action like controlling home electrical appliances and conveying basic communication commands. Arduino Pro Micro is used to emulate a computer mouse to the processor. A processor driven display monitor is used to provide a Graphical User Interface (GUI) for the patient and his ease of use. Buttons with texts on them indicating their functions are continuously highlighted automatically in loop. When the desired button is highlighted, the patient blows, it acts as a trigger and desired action takes place. Also, an audio file is played for the selected command. System for communication through words and sentences using a software keyboard is proposed. Census data is referred for knowledge of how wide the application patient base is. The paper also consists of the details of implementation and testing of our system using real life test cases.

articleTitle: Enhanced Real-Time Mechanical Measurement Monitoring Through Cross- Platform BLE Interface in Windows and Android Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: There are various mechanical measurement techniques used in metrology applications. Measurement data can be acquired from measuring device / instruments like probes, gauges, calibration instruments, using various communication protocols Communication ports (COM Port), Universal Serial Communication ports (USBs), Blue tooth, Ethernet, and many more. In this paper, an attempt has been made to adapt Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), a high end Bluetooth technique to acquire and monitor the measurement data from measuring device/ instrument using Visual Studio C++ platform (with GUI development in QT framework). The detailed method/procedure of data acquisition using BLE technique is clearly described in this paper which is very useful for the development of measurement software using BLE.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence and its Role in Language Games in Mathematics Classrooms
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Utilizing language games in mathematics classrooms is an effective approach to engage students, promoting accessibility across diverse age groups and backgrounds. These games not only enhance comprehension of mathematical concepts but also foster problem-solving prowess and critical thinking. This article delves into the diverse categories of language games employed in math education, their specific objectives, and the advantageous impact they yield in educational settings. Moreover, it explores methods of customizing language games to cater to individual student requirements and offers guidance for educators on optimal strategies for introducing these games. The paper's ultimate goal is to present a thorough analysis of the possible benefits of language games for teaching mathematics by involving the role of artificial intelligence (AI), highlighting their potential as a valuable tool for improving mathematical understanding among students.

articleTitle: Enhancing Rider Safety - A Computer Vision based Approach for Helmet Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Bike riders have been rapidly rising in numerous countries throughout time. Motorcycles are popular among residents from many social strata for a variety of reasons, including their low cost. Helmets are required by law, yet the majority of people choose not to wear them. The primary purpose of the helmet is to protect the riders. This study collects and annotates a variety of datasets, including photographs and video frames with and without helmets. Following that, this study modifies a trained object identification model such that it can recognise helmets in a variety of locations and lighting conditions. This study uses the trained model to analyse real-time video data from cameras positioned in locations. When helmets are recognised, they are marked in the video feed with bounding boxes, allowing spectators to easily identify persons, who follow safety requirements. This study incorporates processing techniques such as non-maximum suppression to improve accuracy. Furthermore, this technology allows you to establish a confidence threshold which will activate warnings or messages if helmets do not achieve the specified degree of confidence or are not identified at all. This study employs cutting-edge deep learning approaches for object detection, allowing persons wearing helmets in video feeds to be identified. To build a customised object identification model particularly built for helmet recognition, we use transfer learning with trained convolutional neural networks (CNNs). The goal of this research work is to create a deep learning-based helmet detection system using trained models and datasets, which will be useful for the police branch in implementing regulations for the good of society. The main aim of this research work is to detect the biker's helmets to enhanced road safety by using deep learning and CNN based algorithms. The proposed model enhances biker's safety and its helpful for the traffic police to check whether they wear the helmet or not while driving.

articleTitle: Design & Implementation of Self Balancing Bot
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: One of the main research areas in the domains of robotics and manipulation engineering is the two-wheeled self-balancing robot. The theory of the inverted pendulum underpins its operation. This paper focuses on improving a wheeled, self-balancing bot's ability to transport items from one location to another. The self-balancing bot is modeled using the concept of a reversed pendulum. It is a personal transportation device that uses advanced balancing technology to maintain its upright position while moving. It typically consists of two parallel wheels, a platform for the rider to stand on, and a control mechanism that allows the rider to steer and control the speed of the device. The self-balancing mechanism works by using sensors to detect the device's orientation and changes in direction or speed. These sensors are typically accelerometers, gyroscopes, and sometimes even barometers or magnetometers, which work together to keep the device balanced and stable. On the other hand, the microcontroller employs programs to instruct the motor driver module on how to rotate the wheels, which help the robot balance, detect obstacles in its path, and notify the user by sounding the buzzer.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey of IoT Applications in Remote Patient Monitoring, Chronic Disease Management, and Smart Healthcare Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This extensive study explores the wide range of Internet of Things (IoT) applications in the areas of remote patient monitoring, chronic disease management, and smart healthcare infrastructure. The review examines the changing role of IoT technology in revolutionizing healthcare paradigms and enhancing patient outcomes. The remote patient monitoring area explores the incorporation of wearable devices and sensors to track health parameters in real-time, promoting continuous and proactive healthcare management. The study investigates the utilization of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions, such as intelligent drug dispensers and interconnected inhalers, to improve adherence to treatment and maximize therapeutic interventions in the management of chronic diseases. The research delves into the advancement of intelligent healthcare infrastructure by integrating hospital equipment and leveraging IoT technology to optimize healthcare workflows. The focus is on the integration of data analytics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to extract practical insights from the data produced by IoT-enabled healthcare systems.

Author Keywords: Chronic diseases and health care systems

articleTitle: Visible Light Communication Based Indoor Positioning System
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: In today's world, we use Global Positioning System(GPS) to get accurate location of the user. Basically, how a GPS works is that it uses satellites which constantly send signals and the receiver of our device interpret these signals. The receiver calculates the distance from multiple satellites and predict the location. However, you might have noticed GPS lacks precision inside multi-storey buildings such as malls, business centers, residential buildings, etc. So we propose the use of Indoor Positioning System(IPS) using Li-Fi technology. Indoor Positioning System helps in providing location where satellite signals are not reachable. Beacons or tags are installed in buildings or on objects to be tracked. Special receivers are used to interpret the signals from these devices and predict exact coordinates of the user or object. The beacons must be installed separately, so we can use already installed LED light bulbs for this purpose. Light Fidelity (Li-Fi) Technology can be integrated with IPS to provide better solutions. Li-Fi uses LEDs to transmit data in Visible Light Spectrum. This is known as Visible Light Communication(VLC). It provides advantages like higher speed, more security, low latency and higher efficiency than Wi-Fi. It basically changes the intensity of LED more quickly than the human eye can percept. The receiver retrieves data and process it. The use of Li-Fi in IPS can provide efficient results. Li-Fi transmitter and receivers are used and Arduino Uno as microcontroller. Every LEDs transmit unique bits and the receiver interpret this to give exact coordinates of the user. This technology can be useful in places where directions are not mentioned or in any way the user is unable to access the directions.

articleTitle: Portable Healthcare Monitoring System in Remote Areas using IoT Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Mobile technologies are an increasing number of growing nations like India. There have been numerous new inquiries and traits on this space. Presently mobile is getting an important tool no longer only in civic regions however additionally in far flung and pastoral regions. The vacuity of low- fee cellular telephones and the previously broad content of GSM networks in India is a big occasion to give services that might spark development and ameliorate human's life. Portable fitness address is device which gives immediately respond on the health circumstance of a stoner. There are numerous conditions that cause bleeding, vomiting or get worse if no longer cured soon and in comparable situations the portability of the health address enables it to present healthcare certainly in the outermost regions within 24 hours. This research work explores the prevailing popularity of cellular grounded health care gadget in our United States of America, faults in health Care management in India, and the implicit result to fill it with the allowing of cellular internet technology for immediate healthcare provision in far off areas.

articleTitle: AI-Driven IoT Framework for Optimal Energy Management in Consumer Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The explosion of Internet of Things (IoT) devices in consumer applications has led to an unprecedented demand for efficient energy management strategies. However, the existing approaches lack intelligence and responsiveness to varying user needs and grid conditions. This research study introduces an innovative AI-driven IoT framework to optimize energy consumption in consumer devices. The proposed framework dynamically adapts energy usage based on a device context, user behavior, and environmental conditions. The proposed framework integrates cutting-edge AI models and algorithms to analyze real-time data streams from IoT devices. In addition to that, the framework integrates real-time energy consumption data from connected devices with AI algorithms for demand forecasting, anomaly detection, and dynamic control. Further, the components and technologies employed illustrate how machine learning enhances decision-making processes for optimal energy efficiency. Experiments in simulated and real-world environments demonstrate significant energy savings of up to 20% compared to conventional methods. The proposed framework offers a scalable and adaptable solution for promoting sustainable energy utilization in the field of consumer electronics.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Learning Model for Detecting Attacks in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Cloud computing has revolutionized how organizations manage and deliver IT services, offering unprecedented scalability and flexibility. However, with this transformation, the cloud infrastructure has become a prime target for cyber-attacks. Detecting and mitigating attacks in cloud computing environments is paramount to ensure data security and business continuity. This paper presents a novel Hybrid Learning Model (HLM) for detecting attacks in cloud computing. The proposed HLM leverages the strengths of both supervised and unsupervised learning techniques to enhance attack detection accuracy and reduce false positives. The proposed approach is the combination of Iterative Intrusion Detection system (IIDS) combined with random forest (RF) as the training model and iterative reinforcement learning based Support Vector Machine (SVM) with transfer Learning is used to classify the types of attacks. The preprocessing techniques used in this paper are Modified Z-Score and SMOTE (Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique) used to clear the data. A feature selection technique Correlation-based Feature Selection (CFS) is also used to select the accurate features from the data.
