It combines the discriminative power of supervised machine learning with the anomaly detection capabilities of unsupervised learning. The model is trained on a diverse dataset of regular and attack traffic to learn the patterns and behaviors of various attacks in a cloud environment. The HLM is evaluated using real-world datasets from cloud environments and compared to traditional detection methods. Our results show that the Hybrid Learning Model significantly improves attack detection accuracy while reducing false positives. This research contributes to the ongoing efforts to enhance the security of cloud computing infrastructures and protect critical data assets.

articleTitle: Ensemble Resource Allocation using Optimized Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Cloud computing has revolutionized how resources are provisioned and managed in the information technology landscape. One of the most critical challenges in cloud computing is efficient resource allocation to ensure optimal utilization of resources while meeting the performance requirements of applications. Traditional resource allocation methods often need to be revised to address the dynamic and complex nature of cloud environments. This research presents an Ensemble Resource Allocation (ERA) in cloud computing using Linear Programming (LP) and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO). PSO is a heuristic optimization technique inspired by the collective behavior of birds and fish. However, PSO, like many optimization algorithms, has its limitations, such as premature convergence and suboptimal solutions. To overcome these limitations, an optimized version of PSO is proposed that enhances its performance in cloud resource allocation. The proposed approach combines PSO with adaptive mechanisms to address the challenges specific to cloud environments. A fitness function is considered not only for resource utilization and application performance but also for cost, energy consumption, and service-level agreements. The multifaceted fitness function ensures that the allocation decisions are made with a holistic view of cloud resource management. Furthermore, the optimized PSO algorithm leverages intelligent heuristics to adjust its parameters dynamically, adapt to changing workloads, and optimize resource allocation continuously. This adaptability allows our approach to efficiently allocate resources under various operating conditions, making it well-suited for real-world cloud environments. In this work, the proposed system is evaluated through extensive simulations and practical experiments, comparing its performance against traditional resource allocation methods. The results demonstrate that the optimized PSO-based approach outperforms existing methods regarding resource utilization, application performance, and overall cost-effectiveness. This research contributes to the ongoing efforts to enhance resource allocation strategies in cloud computing, addressing the complexities of modern cloud environments while ensuring efficient resource utilization. The findings of this study have implications for cloud service providers, enterprises, and organizations seeking to optimize their resource allocation processes and, ultimately, enhance the quality of services delivered through the cloud.

articleTitle: Security Concerns in Cloud and Blockchain Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Cloud computing and blockchain technology are the two transformative technologies that have created significantly impact in various industries. Cloud computing has revolutionized the way resources and services are delivered over the internet, enabling scalable and cost-effective solutions. On the other hand, blockchain has introduced a safe and decentralized structure for recording transactions and maintaining trust in digital interactions. This research study explores the synergy between cloud computing and blockchain, focusing on their combined potential to increase efficiency, privacy, and data security. The integration of cloud computing and blockchain offers several advantages as the technology makes use of the immutability and cryptographic capabilities of blockchain to provide secure and tamper-proof storage of sensitive data. Furthermore, the decentralized structure of blockchain guarantees that data is not under the control of a single entity, enhancing data ownership and privacy. Smart contracts, and programmable scripts on the blockchain, may streamline and automate a variety of cloud-related activities, cutting out mediators and improving productivity.

articleTitle: A Review of Secure IoT Based Smart Health Monitoring System using Blockchain Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The integration of the Internet of Things (IoT) with blockchain technology is significantly transforming smart health monitoring systems. IoT enables the seamless collection of health data, while blockchain's decentralized ledger ensures the integrity and security of this data, mitigating potential breaches. This symbiosis addresses current healthcare challenges by enhancing security, transparency, and efficiency, fostering a patient-focused and reliable monitoring system. With the rise of the Medical Internet of Things (MIoT), personalized and cost-effective healthcare solutions are more accessible, thanks to technologies like Wireless Body Area Networks (WBAN), which improve data quality, and Machine Learning (ML), which effectively processes large datasets. Fog Computing has been instrumental in ensuring efficient data communication with reduced latency, and advancements in Software-Defined Networking (SDN) and Network Function Virtualization (NFV) offer simpler, adaptable networks for healthcare. However, increased data volume raises privacy and security concerns, propelling a shift towards blockchain for enhanced data protection and transparency. Innovations like blockchain-based federated learning aim to safeguard privacy without compromising model accuracy, and smart contracts on platforms like Hyperledger Fabric provide secure patient history logs and immediate access to medical records. Tools such as the Libelium e-Health toolkit further aim to revolutionize monitoring, diagnosis, and treatment processes.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Precision and Efficiency of Fake News Prediction: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: In the digital age, fake news affects public opinion, democracy, and society. The need for efficient and reliable false news detection tools has grown as misinformation spreads swiftly online. This paper reviews recent research on efficient and accurate false news detecting methods. The review begins by describing fake news and its possible effects on society. To reduce misinformation's damage, it stresses prompt and accurate identification. Manual fact-checking and human moderation are critiqued for their inability to handle the size and speed of misinformation. Thus, researchers use computational approaches and machine learning to solve these problems. The research addresses fake news detection using NLP, sentiment analysis, and topic modelling. NLP extracts contextual and linguistic cues, whereas sentiment analysis identifies emotionally manipulative content. Topic modelling helps identify bogus news patterns and themes. The review also examines how recurrent neural networks (RNN s) and transformer-based architectures might detect bogus news. These models have captured complicated textual patterns and advanced false news detection systems. This study emphasizes using varied datasets to train and test false news detection methods. It stresses the importance of representative data for model generalization and robustness and the difficulties of getting reliable labelled datasets. This research study also sheds light on false news detection model development. It emphasizes on computational methods, machine learning, and deep learning to combat misinformation. The study guides researchers and practitioners in developing creative ways to identify fake news quickly and accurately, creating a more educated and resilient digital society.

articleTitle: Blockchain and Internet-of-Things: A Technological Solution for Issues in Cold Chain
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Due to the integration of technology in the form of Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things into the cold chain, the fourth industrial revolution, often known as “Industry 4.0,” evolves as a new technological paradigm. According to the Industry 4.0 vision, the smart cold chain emphasizes worldwide networks of autonomously communicating information along with efficient control systems. Autonomous operation of the smart cold network is made possible by using the cyber-physical system. Since the cooperation between suppliers, manufacturers, producers, and processors, as well as customers, is crucial to improve transparency of all processes from the point of origin to the point of consumption, it is imperative to look at the influence of Industry 4.0 on the entire cold chain. This research study analyzes the application of technology in cold chain and suggests the use of various technologies in the form of solutions to resolve various issues existing in the cold chain.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review on Real-Time Sign Language Detection for Deaf and Dumb People
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Sign language is a critical mode of communication for individuals with hearing and speaking impairments. This research aims to create a precise and efficient model capable of accurately recognizing and translating manual sign gestures into text or speech. The system is trained using a combination of supervised and self-supervised learning approaches, where both labeled and unlabeled data are utilized to improve performance. There are several language models and datasets are available for languages like English but there is limited work has been done on the Marathi language.

articleTitle: Cryptocurrency Price Prediction using LSTM with Self Attention
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Cryptocurrency has taken the financial world by storm, with its value and relevance growing daily. For financial players, predicting cryptocurrency prices accurately has become crucial. Considering the growing importance of cryptocurrencies in the financial industry, this study focuses on the urgent problem of predicting their prices. Previous research in this domain has predominantly employed conventional statistical and machine learning methodologies, artificial neural networks, deep learning, and reinforcement learning. But lot of these methods often prove insufficient in capturing the complex patterns and sentiment analysis that are pivotal in influencing the dynamics of cryptocurrency markets. This research presents a one such method that captures these complex patters that is LSTM with self-attention mechanisms with Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural networks to improve prediction accuracy and compares it with traditional LSTM. Results showcase the self-attention LSTM's ability to identify long-range dependencies, providing a robust solution for navigating the complexities of cryptocurrency markets. Furthermore, the self-attention LSTM demonstrates a notable improvement in R-squared (R2) scores over the traditional LSTM, underscoring its efficacy in capturing nuanced market dynamics and explaining more variance in the cryptocurrency price data.

articleTitle: Optimization Algorithms in Diabetes Prediction: A Comparative Work
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Accurately predicting chronic conditions such as diabetes is essential for prompt treatment and improved patient outcomes. Using the UCI diabetes dataset, this work assesses four optimization algorithms: Adam, RMSprop, Nadam, and Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD). The objective is to evaluate their efficacy in creating precise prediction models by empirical means. These algorithms have a significant impact on the stability and speed of convergence of deep learning models during training. With patient data, machine learning and deep learning models can be used to assess the risk of diabetes. Diabetes is a complex metabolic disease that requires early detection to prevent complications; however, the choice of optimizer has a significant impact on the models' efficacy. As the optimizer with the highest accuracy, precision, and F1 Score, Nadam stands out. SGD does exceptionally well in recall, while Adam and RMSprop do well as well. The choice of optimizer should take trade-offs between measures into account and be in line with specific therapeutic goals. They can be more effectively tuned as hyperparameters in diabetes prediction models. This work improves patient outcomes in the management of diabetes and healthcare risk assessment.

articleTitle: Automatic English Character Entry System based on Novel Optical Character Recognition Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This study presents an automatic English character input system by using a novel optical character recognition (OCR) algorithm to improve the accuracy and efficiency of text recognition. The OCR algorithm integrates Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Fully Convolutional Network (FCN), specifically using the DBNet model to address challenges such as text adhesion. The study focuses on constructing an efficient text database through paradigm theory and relational database design to optimize performance and consistency. The proposed system also incorporates MS-DOC file processing, detailing storage methods for compressed and uncompressed text information. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of the algorithm, which consistently achieves OCR accuracy of over 97% on diverse datasets. Comparative analysis with reference models demonstrates the stability and excellence of the proposed algorithm, reinforcing its potential for real-world applications. This research contributes to the evolution of OCR technology, providing a seamless and effective solution for English character input processes that meets today's technological needs.

articleTitle: Transforming Healthcare with Federated Learning-based Artficial Intelligence: Concepts, Classifications, and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The realm of intelligent healthcare has seen a surge in discussions about transformative technologies, with a focus on federated learning (FL), artificial intelligence (AI), and explainable AI (XAI). Traditionally, healthcare data has been centralized, with a limited number of entities sharing raw data across the industry. However, this approach poses significant risks and challenges. Introducing AI into the healthcare ecosystem opens the door to a multitude of agent collaborators, each capable of working alongside their chosen host. The decentralized nature of FL is a noteworthy aspect, as it ensures that raw data remains within its source while enabling model-based communication within the system. The fusion of FL, AI, and XAI offers the potential to address some of the system's limitations and challenges. This article delves deep into the ways in which FL is revolutionizing healthcare facilities through AI integration. We begin by examining the current landscape of futuristic technologies, including FL, AI, XAI, and their relationship with the healthcare sector. We categorize FL in conjunction with AI, exploring a wide array of applications in healthcare IT. Key issues within the healthcare domain, such as privacy, security, stability, and reliability, are addressed. Furthermore, we showcase practical use cases of FL and AI in medical settings. We conclude by shedding light on the various future directions and avenues of research in the management of healthcare using FL-based AI. In this article, we offer insights into the development and implementation of the Contribution-Aware Federated Learning (CAreFL) system for intelligent healthcare. This system not only optimizes the FL model aggregation process based on evaluation results but also assesses the contributions of FL participants in a fair and transparent manner, ensuring efficiency and confidentiality.

articleTitle: The Use of Artificial Intelligence in Anti-Money Laundering (AML)
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Money Laundering has affected the entire world from its beginning. Financial institutions were threatened by the act of money laundering worldwide. This research study discusses how Artificial Intelligence (AI) can be used to fight against money laundering and also discusses about the three stages of money laundering and the use of AI technologies in these stages to combat the effect of money laundering. Further, this study discusses about the technologies such as Machine Learning (ML), Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) to fight against money laundering. Further, this research study elaborates on how AI can help in establishing effective Anti-Money Laundering (AML) system, which consists of Know Your Customer (KYC), risk management, customer due diligence, and transaction monitoring. This research study discusses about the challenges that outburst while using AI. The challenges encountered are inadequate data concerns, the requirement of a skilled workforce, and the risk of failure and inclination. Further, it also provides possible suggestions for the challenges, such as peril-based technique, incorporation of KYC data, uninterrupted surveillance, and human supervision. Finally, this study concludes by stating the substantial possibility of AI in improving the AML process by detecting and preventing money laundering activities.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Classification of Parkinson Disease using Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Parkinson is an aging-related, progressive neurodegenerative disease that impacts both motor and cognitive function. Although the exact origin of Parkinson disease is largely unknown, genetic and environmental factors are probably involved. In contrast, the pathophysiology of Parkinson's disease at the network level is quite well characterized. Treatment options for Parkinson disease's motor symptoms are pretty good. Deep brain stimulation is also frequently used to treat Parkinson's disease that is resistant to medicines. Parkinson's disease can be challenging to diagnose, especially in its early stages when symptoms may be subtle. Doctors working with Parkinson's patients realized the value of the data generated during diagnosis and treatment and recognized that machine learning algorithms could help identify patterns and biomarkers that might not be apparent through traditional diagnostic methods. In this research study, first the basic clinical aspects of Parkinson disease are reviewed and then the detection or symptoms and classification of Parkinson disease have been implemented using different deep learning algorithms. Six different deep learning algorithms Naive Bayes Classifier, Minimum Distance Classifier using the K-Nearest Neighbors Classifier in Logistic Regression, MLP Classifier and Decision Tree classifier have been analyzed and compared for the most optimum results for prediction of Parkinson's disease. The results show how effective and precise the deep learning algorithms are there in Parkinson disease forecasting. This research study attempts to work in the domain of Parkinson disease detection using deep learning algorithms.

articleTitle: Promoter Prediction in DNA Classification Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The genetic code distinguishing species is stored in DNA (Deoxyribonucleic acid), consisting of four bases: Adenine (A), Cytosine (C), Guanine (G), and Thymine (T). Gene promoters, critical for controlling transcription, are located near transcription start sites. Advances in sequencing technology have accelerated DNA data growth. ML (Machine learning) has greatly aided DNA data analysis. This research aims to classify sequences as promoters or non-promoters accurately, achieving high true positive and true negative rates. We collected 106 human promoter and non-promoter data from the University of California, Irvine, ML repository., built a robust promoter classifier using various machine learning models, and utilized tokenization methods like label encoding for feature vectors with different k-mer sizes (3-mer, 6-mer). Combining 6-mer and PCA improved accuracy. Our system successfully distinguishes DNA sequences as promoters or non-promoters with high accuracy and F1-score, around 91% and 93%, automating the identification of complex biological features in sequence data.

articleTitle: Fabric Defect Detection using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Fabric defect detection plays a crucial role in the textile manufacturing industry's quality control process since it guarantees that customers will receive perfect products. Deep Learning (DL) models have demonstrated a great deal of promise in recent years for accurately identifying fabric defects. The proposed fabric defect identification method combines the best features of two architectures: You Only Look Once (YOLOv4) and Region-based Convolutional Neural Network (R-CNN). While YOLOv4 offers quicker and more effective detection, R-CNN generates region recommendations that allow accurate localization of fabric defects. There are two stages in the proposed system. Initially, region proposals are detected using the R-CNN feature extractor and then a convolutional neural network is used for defect classification. YOLOv4 is used for performing object detection in the second step, where the flaws are concurrently classified and localized. The tests carried out on a fabric defect dataset show that the proposed method outperforms the R-CNN and YOLOv4 models separately. The proposed system is appropriate for real-time fabric flaw detection applications in a variety of sectors due to its high detection accuracy and quick processing time. This study demonstrates how well R-CNN and YOLOv4 together work for fabric flaw detection, providing hope for future developments in the area.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the Field of Corporate Social Responsibility
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The increasing importance of corporate social responsibility is getting recognized by the companies as the businesses are seeking accountability for their impacts on the society. Along with that, the advancement in artificial intelligence technology offers new opportunities to identify and address business-related issues more effectively. This research study explores the role of AI technology and provides a brief overview of all the possible advantages of using AI in CSR initiatives. For the efficient implementation of CSR initiative, the role of AI is explored through a literature review. The use of AI in CSR has various benefits such as better decision-making, cost saving, etc. However, there are certain limitations of the same, such as legal issues. By analyzing the challenges, this research study aims to provide suggestions for the proper implementation of AI in CSR. This research study concludes that, artificial intelligence has the power to significantly improve CSR activities, as it is very important to integrate AI with CSR responsibly and cautiously by considering legal factors and ensuring transparency and accountability.

articleTitle: Integrating PAM Clustering and GTO-Based Cluster Head Selection in WSNs with Multi-Metric Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) are a vital component of modern data-driven applications, ranging from environmental monitoring to industrial automation. Clustering plays a pivotal role in enhancing the efficiency and scalability of WSNs by organizing sensor nodes into clusters, where each cluster is led by a Cluster Head (CH). To optimize cluster formation and CH selection, the study proposes a novel approach that combines the Partitioning Around Medoids (PAM) clustering algorithm with the Giant Trevally Optimizer (GTO) for cluster head selection. Our approach goes beyond traditional clustering methods by incorporating a comprehensive set of metrics to guide the clustering and CH selection processes. These metrics encompass Distance-Based Metrics, which consider proximity between nodes; Energy Metrics, accounting for energy availability and consumption; Energy Efficiency Metrics, aimed at prolonging network lifetime; Load Metrics, to balance the node workload; and Data Correlation Metrics, which capture data dependencies among nodes. The proposed clustering protocol implemented using MATLAB and verified for different network deployment conditions. Results shows that the proposed protocol outperforms all existing protocol in terms of lifetime and packet delivery ratio.

articleTitle: Real-Time Traffic Control Using IoT Nodes Based on Traffic Density Information
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Fortunately, there is currently a Iot of research on traffic management systems and there is still ongoing investigation on intelligent traffic monitoring driven by new technologies involving the Internet of Things (IoT). This study can boost urban growth and enhance decision-making processes by integrating these technologies. The available traffic prediction methods focus primarily on traffic management in cities and highways. However, not much research has been done on closed campuses and collector roads. In addition, it is challenging to engage the public and forge meaningful connections to support their decision-making when customers do not use any smart devices. The goal is to increase mobility by putting roadside messaging devices in place to deliver real-time traffic reports about unexpected traffic events and gridlock. The general public will benefit from these time- saving alerts, particularly during rush hour. Additionally, the system transmits traffic updates from the regulatory authorities. The results of the experiments demonstrate a minimal relative error in road occupancy prediction and a high degree of vehicle recognition accuracy. The model's viability is assessed using a prototype. The project's focus is on real-time feedback for adaptive traffic signals.

articleTitle: Architectural Decorative Image Pattern Recognition in the Context of Iconography for Efficient Information Mining
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This study addresses the crucial task of architectural decorative image pattern recognition in the context of iconography, with an emphasis on efficient information mining. The proposed research work presents a novel algorithm that combines edge detection, ResNet50, and the triplet attention mechanism for image style analysis. The proposed methodology is organized into comprehensive sections, including a literature review that explores various studies in image pattern recognition. The proposed algorithm focuses on overcoming the challenges faced by existing deep learning methods in capturing aesthetic style features. It introduces a multifaceted self-supervised task and incorporates edge detection using the Canny method, followed by the application of ResNet50 with a triplet attention mechanism. The paper then focuses on the optimization of the network structure for the targeted task of architectural decorative image recognition, introducing a feature embedding encoder (FEE) to effectively handle multi-level structures. In the experimental phase, the proposed model is tested against traditional CNN and FCM models, demonstrating superior performance with recognition accuracy consistently ranging from 97% to 99%. The comparative analysis highlights the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm in achieving high accuracy, positioning it as a promising solution for image recognition tasks.

articleTitle: Incorporating Transfer Learning in Engine Health Assessment for Accurate Remaining Useful Life Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Aircraft engines are critical, therefore any move to make them safer, more reliable, and fuel-efficient is highly encouraged. To solve the challenges of flight safety and maintenance expense during aircraft engine operation, a prognostics and health management system is deployed. This system is primarily concerned with flaw detection, health evaluation, and life prediction. Making decisions about aircraft engine operation and maintenance is strongly reliant on estimating the remaining useful life (RUL). This study provides an ensemble transfer learning model for RUL prediction using the C-MAPSS turbofan engine dataset. Pre-processing procedures such as filtering and normalization are used to improve the dataset. The proposed ensemble model for RUL prediction is then trained on the processed data. Some of the well-known transfer learning models that are compared include Xception, ResNet-50, and VGG-16. The ensemble model outperforms the other models, with the highest R2 value of 0.9901. Furthermore, the ensemble model is very effective; it can predict RUL in just 37 seconds, which suggests that it could be useful for keeping an eye on engine health and making decisions about aircraft.

articleTitle: Artistic Image Enhancement Based on Iterative Contrastive Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This research work presents a novel artistic image enhancement algorithm based on iterative contrastive learning to address the challenges of image degradation in computer vision systems. The proposed methodology integrates efficient de-noising, oversampling weight incorporation, and probability distribution control for comprehensive image enhancement. The algorithm is trained on a diverse data-set of low-light images and corresponding references, demonstrating its adaptability to different scenarios. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the algorithm in improving image quality, highlighting its potential for advancements in computational visual systems. The proposed approach contributes to ongoing research in image processing and enhancement, and offers a promising solution to the challenges posed by diverse operational environments and degradation issues in optical representations

articleTitle: Interactive Segmentation of Art Images based on Point Cloud Pre-Training
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This study presents an innovative interactive segmentation algorithm for fine art images using point cloud pre-training principles. With increasing demands for precision and variety in image processing, conventional methods are proving inadequate. Image segmentation, a central aspect of visual data manipulation, involves dividing an image into distinct regions based on static or dynamic features. This study reviews supervised and unsupervised segmentation strategies, emphasizing the importance of fuzzy clustering algorithms in practical applications. Despite advances in medical image segmentation, challenges remain due to the complex nature of image processing. A universally applicable segmentation method and standardized evaluation criteria are elusive. To address these challenges, the proposed algorithm combines Local Binary Pattern (LBP) feature extraction with a point cloud pre-training model, utilizing the U-net architecture for accurate segmentation. Experiments conducted on an Ubuntu 14.04 64-bit OS using C++ and Python demonstrate the effectiveness of the algorithm. The visualized results show its potential for practical applications and lay the foundation for future advances in image segmentation.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Algorithms for Skin Cancer Detection and Classification: Exploring Performance Across Multiple Parameters
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Skin cancer is a substantial health concern, with a yearly incidence of 123,000 new cases and melanoma being the most prevalent variant. Identifying skin diseases is becoming increasingly challenging due to visual similarities. Automated skin cancer screening devices have the potential to enhance accuracy in identifying skin cancers. Advancements in technology and processing capacities have enabled the use of machine and deep learning algorithms for skin lesion examination. However, there is a pressing need for expedited diagnostic systems for life-threatening illnesses. This study provides an overview of various methodologies used in diagnosing skin cancer using image analysis and examines lessons and insights from previous studies. Future directions and scope will help address issues in autonomous detection of skin cancer. In a comparative analysis of various machine learning models, different performance metrics were observed. The Support Vector Machines (SVM) yielded an accuracy of 75.23%, with an AUC of 90.22%. While effective in high-dimensional spaces, SVMs may face limitations with non-linear or noisy data. Random Forest, an ensemble method, demonstrated superior performance with an accuracy of 80.12% and an AUC of 93.22%, possibly due to its proficiency in handling non-linear data structures. Neural Networks, with their ability to model intricate relationships, achieved an accuracy of 81.34%. Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP), a subset of neural networks, slightly varied in performance, indicating potential differences in architecture or training. Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), renowned for image recognition tasks, showcased an impressive accuracy of 93.23%, hinting at the dataset's spatial structures. The Long Short-Term Memory Recurrent Neural Network (LSTM-RNN) emerged as the top performer with an accuracy of 94.344%, suggesting the dataset's potential temporal or sequential patterns. This comparative study underscores the importance of selecting the appropriate model based on the nature and structure of the data.

articleTitle: Audio Detection and Fault Diagnosis of Ultra-High Voltage Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This research work addresses the critical issue of audio detection and fault diagnosis in Ultra High Voltage (UHV) transformers, essential components of power transmission systems. Various faults such as short-circuits, insulation problems and oil temperature anomalies can have a significant impact on power converters and the entire power grid. This study proposes a novel approach using audio signals for real-time fault detection and diagnosis. The proposed methodology involves the extraction of audio signals from ultra-high voltage transformers, taking into account factors such as peak frequency, frequency offset, and total harmonic distortion (THD). A deep neural network is used for systematic analysis and interpretation of these features to enable accurate fault detection. Moreover, this study presents a thorough verification process using an experimental dataset, demonstrating superior detection accuracy compared to existing models. The dataset includes diverse samples of normal and fault scenarios, and the proposed model consistently achieves accuracy levels between 98% and 100%. The results suggest the effectiveness of the proposed audio-based methodology for enabling reliable fault detection in ultrahigh-voltage transformers.

articleTitle: Aural Signatures: Audio Fingerprinting Techniques for Real-Time Audio Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Audio fingerprinting is an essential technique for copyright protection and music recognition. The capacity to accurately categorize audio content and spot possible copyright violations is vital for musicians, content creators, and streaming services. With its valuable solutions for copyright protection, content monitoring, and music recommendation, this study has significant implications for the music industry. In the research, the research focused on developing robust audio fingerprinting methods for precise audio content recognition. These tactics have shown to be remarkably accurate and quite effective. The approach is based on the use of strong hashing techniques and the extraction of various audio aspects. Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) along with SVM, KNN, and CNN were employed in the research. Notably, LSTM outperformed other models, showcasing an outstanding accuracy rate of 93 %. The results hold particular promise for massive music platforms and instantaneous content matching. The proposed methods have demonstrated the effectiveness of these strategies in identifying audio material, even under challenging conditions.

articleTitle: CNN based Image-Denoising Techniques- A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Image denoising is a fundamental task within the realms of computer vision and image processing, with the objective of removing unwanted noise while preserving essential characteristics of the image. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have exhibited impressive capabilities across a range of computer vision tasks, with image denoising being one notable application. This research study gives a thorough overview of the many image denoising methods when CNN is used, with a particular emphasis on the developments and applications of this fascinating area. The importance of image denoising in numerous applications, including medical imaging, surveillance, and photography, is highlighted in the paper's introduction. By systematically examining CNN-based denoising techniques and their practical uses, the objective of this research study is to offer researchers and practitioners a thorough comprehension of the advancements in CNN-based image denoising application.

articleTitle: Evaluating Human Emotions Using Image Processing and Brain Waves
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Human sentiments are analyzed based on two prominent technologies, electroencephalography and image processing. Electroencephalography helps in detecting the brains activity by attaching the electrodes to the scalp. The neurons are charged with ions and constantly emit them. When charged ions repel and propagate this repulsion, a brain wave is produced at a unique frequency depending on the state of mind. Image processing helps in determining the characteristics of facial expression using mathematical operations and functions. This includes capturing image or more appropriately 20 signals. The output of image processing yields the characteristics of the image. The combined output of both Electroencephalography device and image processing are mapped together to genuinely analyze the human emotions.

articleTitle: AI-Enhanced Data Mining for Fraud Detection in Financial Transactions
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Financial frauds are on the rise globally, causing significant financial losses. This issue has far-reaching consequences, impacting the investment industry, government, and corporate sectors alike. Manual verifications and inspections are inaccurate, expensive, and time consuming for detecting such fraudulent operations. Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) techniques should be used intelligently to identify fraudulent transactions by evaluating enormous amounts of financial data. The paper outlines a process of detecting financial fraud with the application of AI and machine learning. Finally, the paper discusses how organizations can leverage AI techniques for the detection of financial frauds.

articleTitle: Communication Signal Enhancement Algorithm in Low SNR and Complicated Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This research presents a novel communication signal enhancement algorithm tailored for the low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) scenarios in satellite communications. Departing from traditional linear processing, the algorithm exploits the bistable nature of stochastic resonant systems and exploits their nonlinear effects to enhance signals and suppress noise. Key optimizations include antenna system revisions, adjustments to improve signal coverage and strength, and strategic manipulation of electromagnetic wave emission positions. Collectively, these refinements address the challenges in mobile communication signals caused by multipath effects and transmission limitations, thereby advancing the development of wireless communication technology. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is demonstrated through a comprehensive review of recent advances in communication systems and systematic experiments that validate its performance in various scenarios. This innovative approach, encapsulated within a wireless communication system framework, promises to overcome SNR challenges in satellite communications, paving the way for improved signal quality in complex environments.

articleTitle: Optimizing Controller Tuning using Bio-Inspired Algorithms for Robot Path Tracking
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: In the field of industrial and commercial robotics, there has been a recent boom in research towards the navigation of wheel-based mobile robots. There are numerous aspects of this complex problem that need fixing, including issues with sensory data gathering and processing, trajectory planning, and controlling motion. In the field of motion control, creating reliable trajectory controllers is the highest priority. This study improves the Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) controller using Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) and Cat Swarm Optimization (CSO) to get the best possible trajectory tracking. The kinematics of a two-wheeled mobile robot serve as the foundation for its mathematical model. The user-specified reference trajectory is given to the robot. The conventional PID, ACO-PID, and CSO-PID controller's trajectory tracking capacity are evaluated using the metrics. The performance metrics such as the Integral of Squared Error (ISE), Integral of Absolute Error (IAE), and Integral of Time-weighted Absolute Error (ITAE) are taken. According to the simulation results, the CSO-PID controller beats the conventional PID and ACO-PID controllers in terms of error metrics. This discovery highlights the effectiveness of using CSO-PID to improve the trajectory-tracking performance of mobile robots.

articleTitle: Analysis of English Pronunciation Transformation Text Model based on Neural Network Pattern Recognition Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This study proposes an English pronunciation transformation text model based on a neural network pattern recognition algorithm, which aims to address various challenges in speech processing through in-depth analysis and innovative approaches. The paper first introduces the basic principles of pattern recognition, emphasizing the transition from feature space to decision space. Subsequently, a literature review highlights the transformative impact of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) in diverse domains, including financial markets, neuroimaging, environmental monitoring, and more. Methodologically, the paper describes a novel pattern recognition algorithm based on spiking neural networks. The algorithm overcomes the limitations of multi-layer network learning through the Spike Propagation (Spike Prop) algorithm, which introduces error back-propagation for effective training. Ensemble methods are used to improve the generalization ability of the system, with a focus on neural network integration. For pronunciation transformation in text models, sound features are extensively studied, including features such as short-term energy, short-term average amplitude, and Mel-frequency cepstrum coefficients. The experimental part, conducted in a Windows 10 environment using Python, TensorFlow, and GTX1660 GPU, demonstrates positive results across 30 experimental groups. The system shows significant improvements in character recognition accuracy, a reduction in missing and multiple word occurrences, a reduction in typos, and an increase in word accuracy. These results provide a solid foundation for the future research and practical applications in natural language processing.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment and Management in Stock Trading using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Making determinations in the ever-changing world of stock trading has frequently involved a complicated interaction between information and experience. With so many companies to choose from, investors frequently find it difficult to identify profitable options. The transformational potential of artificial intelligence (AI) to improve and streamline stock trading decisions is explored in this study. Support Vector Machines (SVM), Principal Component Analysis (PCA), and Neural Networks (NN) are three different approaches that are combined in this study to create a strong stock recommendation system that is compatible with investor strategies and risk tolerance. To improve computational efficiency, traders with similar tastes were grouped together using hierarchical clustering. The results showed promise. The NN model demonstrated a training accuracy of 94.8%, whilst the SVM model displayed an accuracy of 92.3%. The fact that PCA was able to capture all of the dataset's variation with just five main components demonstrated its superiority. Moreover, an evaluation of Value-at-Risk and Expected Returns for the suggested portfolios revealed the intrinsic trade-off between possible benefits and related hazards. This study essentially highlights the enormous potential of AI to transform stock trading by providing accurate recommendations that maximize profitability while blending in with investor profiles.

articleTitle: Fatty Liver Disease Prediction Through Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Fatty Liver Disease (FLD) is a medical condition that poses potential health risks and can affect individuals of various age groups, irrespective of demographic factors. The field of machine learning (ML) has experienced considerable progress in the analysis of medical data, facilitating the discovery of concealed information that plays a vital role in the diagnosis of fatty liver disease (FLD). Liver disorders, such as Fatty Liver Disease, exert a significant influence on the population, necessitating substantial research focus. The main aim of this study is to utilize a blend of machine learning algorithms, specifically XGBoost (XGB), Naive Bayes (NB), Random Forest (RF), and an Artificial Neural Network (ANN), to effectively forecast the incidence of fatty liver disease. To accomplish this goal, the research employed a machine learning methodology and proceeded to train the chosen algorithms (XGBoost, Naive Bayes, Random Forest, and ANN) using appropriate datasets for FLD prediction. The accuracy score and confusion matrix were used to evaluate the performance of the classification algorithm. This made it possible to get a full picture of both its accuracy and its ability to classify. The study exhibited effective utilization of machine learning algorithms to accurately forecast the incidence of fatty liver disease. The accuracy score and confusion matrix were found to be useful metrics for evaluating the algorithms' precision in detecting instances of FLD. The results underscore the potential of machine learning algorithms in accurately predicting FLD, thereby enabling early detection and enhanced management. The augmentation of prediction accuracy and personalized approaches to addressing the complexities of fatty liver disease can be achieved through additional validation and exploration of advanced technologies, including imaging techniques and the integration of multi-omics data. Further investigation in this field exhibits potential for the development of more efficient approaches to address FLD and associated hepatic conditions, thereby making a valuable contribution to the enhancement of public health outcomes.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Cardiac Healthcare: A Comprehensive IoT and ML-based Remote Cardiac Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The prevalence of cardiovascular diseases as a source of sickness and mortality around the world calls for early detection and efficient management for better patient outcomes and lower health care costs. The limits of traditional diagnostic techniques, such as electrocardiography (ECG), are brought on by the need for specialized equipment and qualified medical professionals. To enable remote cardiac illness diagnosis and management, this study introduces a new smart health monitoring system that makes use of ECG sensors, the Internet of Things (IoT), and machine learning. The system uses wireless sensors to continually gather real-time ECG data from patients. It then sends this data to a cloud server via an IoT gateway where it is analyzed by a machine learning model that has been trained on different heart conditions. Following the development of customized treatment plans based on the specific needs of each patient, healthcare practitioners are instantly alerted to any potential issues discovered through forecasts. The system's accuracy and dependability are rigorously evaluated using real data, and ethical and legal issues are painstakingly taken into account to safeguard patient autonomy and privacy. With the potential to improve patient outcomes, lower healthcare costs, enable remote patient monitoring, and support individualized care, this suggested system has the power to change the diagnosis and treatment of cardiac disease.

articleTitle: A Game Theoretic Approach for Modeling Composite Network-Cloud Service
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Traditional way of computing required only stand-alone systems and applications. As time passed on, the amount of computing raised such that form the distributed platform for system and applications. That paved the way for distributed computing. Nowadays we talk about grid and cloud. Cloud computing is a model of computing in which the IT resources required by the end users are provided without any disruption and they are contented. The benefit of using cloud computing is to offer requested services of customer without any delay or interruption. This could be achieved by having good network services. The network which forms the backbone of the connectivity can be virtualized so that it leads to a novel epoch of integrating cloud computing and networking resources using Service Oriented Architecture paradigm. This article describes about a review of different systems that support network virtualization. This study lists out the challenges that are faced while converging cloud and network services. This study also proposes a theoretical model which involves game theory, that helps in realizing this convergence thus laying a foundation for upcoming generation internet. The game theory involves Nash Equilibrium in finding the best Infrastructure provider and Network Service Provider. Also, the best strategy among them is found for the user. Network calculus is extended to involve cloud service along with network services that helps in evaluating the composite service's performance.

articleTitle: Information Retrieval and Recommendation Framework Based on ChatGPT
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This research presents an innovative information retrieval and recommendation framework that leverages ChatGPT's capabilities to navigate the evolving landscape of language use and information growth. Focused on improving search services, the proposed ChatGPT-powered Internet data collection model integrates web crawlers for task-oriented extraction. The information retrieval algorithm uses word vectorization to address challenges in query expansion through semantic and associative matching. Collaborative filtering further improves recommendation accuracy. Carefully conducted experiments in a configured environment evaluate the framework's performance using random dataset partitioning. Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) metrics, averaged over multiple trials, measure the effectiveness of the algorithms. This research contributes a valuable framework that provides insight into recommendation algorithms within the ChatGPT paradigm, paving the way for future advances in intelligent information retrieval systems.

articleTitle: A Survey Based on FinFET Breaking the Moore's Law Barrier with Future Wireless Communication System
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The device miniaturization and enhanced performance in semiconductor technology has prompted the exploration beyond conventional CMOS, leading to innovative transistor designs. Among these advancements, FinFET technology stands out as a promising candidate capable of overcoming the limitations imposed by Moore's Law. This survey delves into the intricacies of FinFET technology and its pivotal role in surpassing the Moore's Law barrier, providing a comprehensive overview of its fundamental principles. Highlighting the unique three-dimensional structure and improved electrostatic control of FinFETs, the paper explores their implications for the future of wireless communication systems. It emphasizes how the char-acteristics of FinFET technology align with the demands of next-generation communication protocols. In addition to discussing the architectural advantages of FinFETs, the survey addresses the challenges associated with their widespread adoption, in-cluding a focus on power efficiency, speed, and overall system performance. Potential solutions to these challenges are also ex-plored. Furthermore, the survey critically analyzes existing liter-ature, summarizing key findings from recent research and development efforts related to FinFET technology. This encompasses advancements in manufacturing processes, device integration techniques, and the application of FinFETs in emerging wireless communication standards. At the crossroads of semiconductor innovation and wireless communication evolution, this survey aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of how FinFET technology serves as a catalyst in breaking traditional Moore's Law constraints. By exploring synergies between FinFETs and future wireless communication systems, this survey contributes to the ongoing discourse on the trajectory of semiconductor tech-nology beyond conventional limits, acknowledging and addressing the challenges posed by FinFET adoption.

articleTitle: From Farmers to Consumers: Optimization of Food Supply Chain Using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The globalization of the food sector has resulted in significant challenges related to food supply chains. The current methodology of using RFID Technology lacks in certain aspects. To address the challenges, Blockchain technology has evolved as a suitable decentralized solution with transparency, increased security, reduced transaction costs, and overall efficiency. This system intends to achieve integrated data management, real-time tracking of food products, automated traceability management, and prompt data transmission. Its purpose is to address issues related to technology, cost, security, privacy, and governance that create a strong bond between the supply chain entities and consumers. The result is the possibility of transforming the world's food supply chain and establishing transparency and traceability with overall efficacy. The proposed system intends to demonstrate how Blockchain can be adapted to transform the food supply chain from how food is produced, distributed, and consumed on a global level. Moreover, it guarantees process simplification, eliminates excess operative inefficiency, and manifests the accuracy of data provided with labels.

articleTitle: A Novel Image Information Mining and Saliency Modeling for Visual Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This research addresses the transformative landscape of visual communication design in the information age, driven by the profound impact of digital virtualization. The shortcomings of traditional media are addressed by introducing an innovative methodology for image information mining and saliency modeling. The proposed approach emphasizes the integration of multi-scale features to enhance design expressiveness and alignment with input images. The literature review explores various visual communication applications, from effective data representation to intelligent urban planning. Experimental verification demonstrates the model's commendable performance in visual saliency detection, with nuanced key performance indicators providing insights and suggesting optimization paths. This research contributes to a deeper understanding of the impact of digital virtualization on visual communication, and provides a comprehensive framework for future research in this evolving field. The proposed methodology not only addresses current challenges, but also sets the stage for continued advancements in visual communication design within the dynamic landscape of the information age.

articleTitle: From Blueprint to Build: The Symbiotic Relationship of Digital Twins and Physical Construction
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The construction industry has entered a transformative era marked by increased efficiency, safety, and stakeholder engagement with the deployment of digital twins. This research study offers a quantitative analysis on how digital twins affect several building projects. Important results show a significant decrease in project delays (15%), resource waste (22%), and on-site safety incidents (30%). Stakeholder satisfaction (28%) energy efficiency (20%) and cost predictability (35%) have all significantly improved. Because of technology's ability to connect the digital and physical worlds, data security has been strengthened, workflows have been improved, and resource allocation has been maximized. The research findings highlights how useful digital twins may be as a key instrument in contemporary construction, offering the possibility of cost savings, on-time project completion, and increased asset longevity. emergence of digital twins is set to reshape industry norms as construction industry continues to change, placing a greater emphasis on data-driven decision-making and proactive problem-solving.

articleTitle: Intervention of Artificial Intelligence in Education to Reduce Illiteracy Rate
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) can speed up the progress, provide novel teaching and learning techniques, and address some of the largest issues in education. It combines cognition, machine learning, interaction of human and computer, storage of data, recognition of emotion, and decision making to make machines think and act like humans. Digitalization is a process that involves orientation, digital preparation, interactive presence, teamwork, follow-up and performance, reflection and motivation, and examination evaluation. Technology Enhanced Learning (TEL) is being developed to help students in their academic pursuits with AI-supported time and task planning (AI4TTP). AI can be used to influence people in a variety of ways, such as through chatbots, e-assessment, and anti-cheating systems. Learning analytics (LA) is a new area that aims to improve education and instruction by assessing raw information analytically and identifying trends to recognize behaviour of students, anticipate learner actions, and present quick feedback. Individualized instruction is tailored to each learner's individualized learning inclinations. There has been discussion of suggestions based on the analysis.

articleTitle: A Review of Enhancement in Security of an IoT System Using BlockChain
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The Internet of Things is thriving rapidly in terms of quality and quantity, helping us to provide better services every day. With the wide-spread growth of the Internet of Things, it introduces new technical challenges, such as managing a vast number of devices. In almost every field, like smart homes, smart transactions, automobiles, and healthcare, IoT is being used very effectively. Even though so many architectures and frameworks are proposed to overcome these challenges, security and scalability are major challenges for an IoT system. Additionally, IoT technology has been merged with other advanced technologies, such as cloud computing, big data, and blockchain, to form a strong IoT system. Blockchain is an emerging technology that is based on distributed protocols. It has the potential to ensure the security, scalability, and reliability of an IoT system and can provide secure digital transactions. This paper attempts to identify the current contributions to IoT security using blockchain and highlights various research gaps in this area. The paper concludes with a discussion on open challenges and research issues.

articleTitle: Intelligent Building System based on Multi-Modal Optimization of Energy Data Center
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This study introduces an intelligent building system designed for comprehensive data management, which integrates various subsystems to regulate devices and technologies in buildings. As a fundamental pillar of smart buildings, building mechanization mechanisms improve efficiency, reduce energy consumption, and prioritize human interests. This study specifically focuses on multimodal optimization within energy data centers, employing innovative strategies to improve system efficiency, with special emphasis on energy resource management in data centers. The proposed system integrates ZigBee-based sensor networks, tilt sensors, and temperature sensors for comprehensive architectural security monitoring. A semantic data model based on metadata is applied for improved analysis and representation of multimodal data, contributing to improved clarity and efficiency in data management. The proposed research study also addresses issues related to uninterruptible power supply (UPS) and automatic repair of primary physical connection relationships in building electromechanical systems. The final intelligent building system design includes a hierarchy of integrated platforms with communication interface layers, core control layers, and user interface layers. The effectiveness of the system is demonstrated through a systematic simulation using the METASYS building control system. The experiment shows the successful implementation of Modbus communication for power conversion and distribution systems, highlighting the practical application of the proposed intelligent building system.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Inventory Management: The Role of IoT in Inventory Management 4.0
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Inventory management 4.0 signifies a new phase in the field of inventory management. It is made possible with the seamless integration of the new cutting-edge technologies. Inventory management relies on various conventional methods such as recording orders on paper and counting items physically. This research study analyzes the potential advantages of all these advanced technologies used in inventory management. In addition, it examines the potential of implementing the Internet of Things (IoT) and sensors, which can eventually help in enhancing the safety and transparency of various inventory operations. Items in the inventory model are monitored closely by IoT devices which includes RFID tags, and sensors. The study's findings help us know that many industries are giving more importance to research on this topic. In addition, IoT technology enables the tracking of goods and enhances the efficiency of inventory management. Based on the analysis, the Internet of Things (IoT)-based inventory management system tracks inventory in real-time and gives companies up-to-date stock information. Finally, based on the thorough analysis of challenges faced by technology and future recommendations have been provided.

articleTitle: Visual Question Answering in Malayalam Text
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: One of the most important tasks in combining computer vision and natural language understanding is Visual Question Answering (VQA). This paper focuses on the VQA problem in Malayalam, a language known for its unique Dravidian linguistic characteristics. The robust LXMERT model, a bidirectional encoder-decoder architecture capable of handling multimodal input, is used to achieve this goal. Extensive testing on an independent set of Malayalam images and questions highlights the feasibility of building a trustworthy VQA model on a Malayalam dataset. The method shows adaptability when answering questions about Malayalam images, which creates opportunities for image retrieval, annotation, and possibly image-based machine translation. This demonstrates how the model can be applied to real-world situations in a variety of fields.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey of Blockchain Technology-Trust as a Service
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: In today's rapidly changing digital world, security and trust remain as an essential element supporting a range of communications, transactions, and distributed systems. With the invention of blockchain technology, a trust may now be provided as “Trust as a Service (TaaS),” a decentralized, verifiable, and essential asset rather than a centralized digital network. In a decentralized and distributed ledger network, the blocks are connected in chronological order, and information is saved using distributed ledger techniques. Since the start of the deployment, blockchain has kept a record of all transactions. This research study analyses the explores the blockchain technology and analyze how it functions as a trusted provider across a range of industries. Also, this study investigates the fundamental ideas behind blockchain, its development, and the cryptographic security systems. This research study illustrates how blockchain maintains confidence in data quality, security, transparency, and immutability across a range of applications, including banking, supply chain, healthcare, and governance. This study also emphasizes the difficulties and possibilities present in the rapidly developing blockchain ecosystem and further discusses about the issues and challenges and various blockchain attacks, solutions, and tools. Finally, the open issues and solutions are analysed.

articleTitle: Generative AI Models and Capabilities in Cancer Medical Imaging and Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Cancer is an overarching term encompassing over number of distinct diseases characterized by the uncontrolled proliferation of abnormal cells. These diseases occur when abnormal cells proliferate uncontrollably, exceeding their usual boundaries to invade adjacent body structures and potentially disseminate to distant organs. It stands as a noteworthy global health concern, prompting ongoing research aimed at gaining a deeper understanding of its root causes, devising more effective treatments and refining early detection methods. Advancements in fields like genomics, immunology and artificial intelligence are contributing to our comprehension of cancer and the creation of innovative approaches to diagnosis and treatment. Early detection and improvements in cancer therapy have intensified survival rates for many cancer types, yet it continues to position a substantial health challenge worldwide. Deep learning has emerged as an effective tool in the cancer diagnosis, promising enhanced accuracy, efficiency, and speed in various aspects of cancer assessment. Artificial intelligence algorithms that use the deep learning method are effective at analyzing medical imaging like Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI), X-radiation images, Computerized Tomography (CT) scans, and to identify and classify malignant anomalies. Moreover, deep learning can be connected to extract quantitative features from medical images, a discipline known as radiomics, which yields valuable insights for characterizing tumors and forecasting their prognosis. Extending the possibility, innovative technologies like Generative Artificial Intelligence (GAI) assumes a pivotal role in the domain of cancer diagnosis by producing synthetic data, images, or simulations that lend invaluable support to various features of cancer detection and analysis. These technologies find application across the spectrum of cancer related tasks, spanning detection, diagnosis, prognosis, treatment optimization, drug discovery and patient care. This research study discovers the character of Generative Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning algorithms in cancer prediction, covering their current applications, limitations, and future prospects.

articleTitle: Analysis on Artificial Intelligence based Human Resource Computer Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: Human resource management and competitiveness are becoming increasingly crucial in the growth of businesses. This study examines the factors of the enterprise survival environment in the process model of human asset management from the perception of control and computing. Based on systematic analysis, this study employs the SWOT is an acronym that stands for Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, Threats, and analysis algorithm to creatively examine the contact of corresponding environmental elements on human resource management mode, and formulates a comprehensive set of human resource development plan. Simultaneously, in light of the control and computer challenges that exist in the human resource model, this study proposes specific implementation rules and methods, and theoretically verifies the efficacy and reliability of the related rules. By eliminating bias, automating tedious procedures, and empowering HR staff to make data-driven judgments, AI may expedite the hiring process. AI may save HR teams time and resources by, for instance, scheduling interviews, reviewing resumes, and performing preliminary candidate screening. It makes possible a data-driven strategy for hiring, promoting, and retaining people that aims to reduce bias and improve the experiences of both job searchers and workers.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Algorithm for Predicting Soil Classification using Smart Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The advent of Internet of Things (IoT) technology and data analytics has brought about a significant transformation in contemporary agricultural practices, sometimes referred to as smart agriculture. One of the fundamental uses of this technology is the prediction of soil classification, a critical factor in the optimization of crop management strategies and the allocation of resources. The present work investigates the use of machine learning techniques to achieve precise and efficient soil categorization in the context of smart agriculture. The study utilizes a comprehensive dataset consisting of several soil characteristics, including pH levels, moisture content, texture, and nutrient composition. These attributes were obtained via the use of Internet of Things (IoT) sensors and Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Several machine learning techniques, such as Random Forest, Support Vector Machine, and Neural Networks, are assessed in terms of the classification accuracy in identifying soil types using the given characteristics. The findings indicate that machine learning models has the capability to accurately forecast soil categorization, hence enabling the use of precision agricultural techniques. These models assist farmers in making informed choices based on data analysis pertaining to crop selection, irrigation, and fertilization, resulting in enhanced agricultural productivity and the adoption of sustainable resource management practices. Additionally, this research investigates the interpretability of the chosen machine learning models, with the aim of ensuring that farmers are able to grasp and place faith in the forecasts. The proper implementation of smart agricultural systems also involves addressing ethical problems related to data privacy and security. This study makes a valuable contribution to the progress of sustainable agriculture via the use of machine learning and Internet of Things (IoT) technology. By leveraging these technologies, the research aims to raise the precision of soil categorization, hence resulting in enhanced agricultural production and a greater focus on environmental conservation.

articleTitle: Novel Defense Method of Malicious Code Injection in High Concurrency Database
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: This research study presents a novel defense method against malicious code injection in high concurrency databases. The proposed approach combines a reliable high concurrency database design with a defense model that emphasizes the importance of robustness, accuracy, and speed. The system incorporates a caching model to optimize response speed and introduces a multi-core HTTP server based on Node.js for efficient high concurrency processing. To protect against code injection, a randomization algorithm is applied that adds random prefixes to HTML and J avaScript keywords in trusted server-side code. This algorithm ensures that the random prefixes are time-sensitive, making the system more resilient to dynamic attacks. Two security modules, a randomization module and a random prefix parser module, work in tandem to identify and filter out potential attacks, particularly XSS vulnerabilities. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method in maintaining high and stable detection accuracy (97% to 99%) compared to alternative approaches, demonstrating its reliability in defending against potential threats. This research provides an innovative solution to improve the security and performance of distributed systems facing high concurrency challenges.

articleTitle: Deployment of an Advanced Wi-Fi Data Firewall System to Enhance Security in the IoT Ecosystem
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Sentiment Analysis and Deep Learning (ICSADL)
abstract: The need for effective security measures has expanded enormously in the fast-changing Internet of Things (IoT) environment of today. Protecting the confidentiality and integrity of data flows has become increasingly important as more devices connect to networks, especially in corporate settings where sensitive information is shared. The proposed set out on a quest to envision and put into practice a thorough Wi-Fi Data Firewall using the adaptable ESP32 development board in order to address these important issues, strengthen IoT security, and Employ optimization techniques like algorithmic efficiency and resource management to reduce computation load. This research primarily focuses on developing an intelligent security gateway to safeguard data for the Internet of Things while monitoring, auditing, and identifying intrusions. The system's brain is the ESP32 microcontroller, which is used to connect to Wi-Fi networks and gather all the data in the suggested innovation. To increase the high security for IoT data, a solution has been proposed: a filter algorithm based on the ESP32 board used here to filter all the data that organization used to send or receive through internet or intranet. All the algorithm has been stored in the esp32 so that real-time monitoring and filtering can be done based on the stored algorithm. IP filtering is accomplished by comparing source and destination IP addresses with predefined rules deciding whether to allow or deny packets based on these addresses. The main goal of the proposed hardware to provide a flexible & adaptive Wi-Fi Data Firewall based on hardware filter for use in office and commercial networks so that it can improve those networks' overall security posture. Additionally, this hardware-based firewall helps to monitor and quick detection of security threats and provide alert of any breaches to the organization's authority. The purpose of this study is to provide IoT data security filter and monitoring for the organization based on the hardware algorithm.
